title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

Qventus is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to pioneer new data solutions at Qventus. Our Data team ensures that Qventus data users have the data they need to build and drive new and existing Qventus products at scale and cost. This includes bidirectional integration with hospital EMR sources via multiple channels (eg. FHIR), complex highly secure (HIPAA) transformations capable of normalizing information across various workflows and client nuances, integration with & discovery of multiple third party datasets from customer data to big-data claims, and more. Our products span the machine learning based orchestrations, real time hospital reporting, analytical insights, and interactive applications needed to improve the lives of patients and doctors across the country.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and management across investments data assets & data pipelines. You will identify, monitor, and lead initiatives to collect, explore, and model data in close partnership with our data modeling lead and integrations partners. You will work closely with solution experts to design, iterate, and develop strategic enhancements to our Qventus foundational data model. You will be adept in partnering with cross-functional partners and data users to translate functional needs into data requirements and quality checks. You will be data curious and excited to have an impact on the team and in the company and to improve the quality of healthcare operations.

Key Responsibilities

Spearhead the discovery, evaluation, and integration of new datasets, collaborating (incl. pipeline development and data modeling/documentation) working closely with key data stakeholders to understand their impact and relevance to our core products and the healthcare domain.
Facilitate the technical management of data assets - clearly tracking and maintaining context on the data within the dataset lifecycle and sustaining tight partnerships with immediate partners on ingestion & solution data engineering
Translate product / analytical vision into highly functional data pipelines supporting high quality & highly trusted data products (incl. designing data structures, building and scheduling data transformation pipelines, improving transparency etc.).
Set the standard for data engineering practices within the company, guiding the architectural approaches, data pipeline designs, and the integration of cutting-edge technologies to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

Excellent cross-functional communication - the ability to break down complex technical components for technical and non-technical partners alike
Innate aptitude for interpreting complex datasets with demonstrated ability to discern underlying patterns, identify anomalies, and extract meaningful insights, demonstrating advanced data intuition and analytical skills. (Healthcare experience preferred)
Excellence in quality data pipeline design, development, and optimization to create reliable, modular, secure data foundations for the organization's data delivery system from applications to analytics & ML
Proven ability to independently handle ambiguous project requirements and lead data initiatives from start to finish, while collaborating extensively with cross-functional, non-technical teams to inform and shape product development.

Bonus Points For

5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating cloud-based, highly available, observable, and scalable data platforms utilizing large, diverse data sets in production to meet ambiguous business needs
Relevant industry certifications in a variety of Data Architecture services (Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer or Solutions Architect Professional, SnowPro® Advanced Architect/Data Engineer, Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer, and dbt Analytics Engineering).
Experience with MLOps and/or developing and maintaining machine learning models and infrastructure
Experience with data visualization tools and analytics technologies (Sigma, Looker, Tableau, etc.)
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). Our commitment to equal opportunity employment applies to all persons involved in our operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee, including supervisors and co-workers.

Qventus participates in the E-Verify program as required by law and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in compliance with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). In compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Qventus provides transparency into how applicant data is processed during the application process. Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our candidate privacy notice.

*Benefits and perks are subject to plan documents and may change at the company's discretion.

*Employment is contingent upon the satisfactory completion of our pre-employment background investigation and drug test.

title: Full-Stack Developer | AI & Automation
description:
Hello Management is seeking a skilled, independent full-stack developer to design, build, improve, and maintain business applications, integrations, and automation solutions.

This is a hands-on development role focused on delivering reliable software, connecting business systems, improving existing functionality, and creating practical AI-enabled workflows. It is not primarily a helpdesk or platform-administration role.

You will collaborate with the Technology Manager and business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, testable technical deliverables.

We are looking for someone who can take a defined technical assignment and execute it independently, with strong attention to functionality, reliability, security, and documentation.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Application Development & Maintenance*

* Develop, troubleshoot, enhance, and maintain web applications, dashboards, and business reporting tools.
* Build, enhance, and maintain internal business applications and digital tools that support operational efficiency.
* Deliver prioritized features and fixes in short Agile cycles, with defined ownership, target timelines, code review, testing, and documented handoff.
* Use AI-assisted development responsibly, reviewing and testing generated code before delivery.

*Systems, Integrations & Automation*

* Implement software integrations and automated workflows based on defined business requirements.
* Build reliable integrations using supported interfaces, appropriate access controls, and sound data-handling practices.
* Develop and maintain AI-enabled automations that reduce repetitive work while supporting appropriate oversight, error handling, and accountability.
* Coordinate with business-system specialists on integrations, shared workflows, and data consistency.

*Technical Execution & Support*

* Troubleshoot technical issues related to assigned applications, configurations, and integrations.
* Test implementations, identify defects, and complete necessary corrections.
* Maintain organized code, technical documentation, and change records.
* Follow established development, information-security, access-control, testing, and release procedures.
* Keep assigned tasks updated on a shared workboard, participate in weekly planning and reviews, and promptly flag blockers, dependencies, or delivery risks.

*Required Skills & Experience*

* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining web applications.
* Practical experience with modern web development languages, frameworks, and maintainable application architecture.
* Experience with APIs, authentication, system integrations, and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with source control, collaborative development, and code-review workflows.
* Experience with databases, debugging, testing, error handling, data reliability, and troubleshooting live applications.
* Ability to use AI-assisted coding tools effectively while reviewing and validating generated code.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
* Good written communication and organizational skills.

*Preferred Technical Experience*

*Experience in the following areas is particularly valuable:*

* Full-stack web application development and maintenance.
* Relational databases, authentication, and secure data access.
* Cloud hosting, deployment pipelines, and version control.
* AI-assisted coding and agent-based development methods.
* Workflow automation and no-code or low-code integrations.
* Third-party APIs and business-system integrations.
* Familiarity with AppFolio or similar property-management platforms, including vendor-supported integrations, APIs, and workflow automation, is a plus but not required.

Candidates do not need experience in every area listed but should be comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies.

*What We're Looking For*

* Can independently plan and complete assigned technical deliverables, make sensible progress asynchronously, and raise questions before making unsupported assumptions.
* Has practical experience building and maintaining working solutions, not just generating code.
* Understands the importance of testing, documentation, and secure development.
* Can communicate progress, technical limitations, and implementation concerns clearly.
* Takes ownership of assigned deliverables and follows through to completion.
* Is adaptable, organized, and interested in using technology and AI to improve business operations.

*Scope & Delivery Boundaries*

* Deliver assigned work with clear documentation of completed changes, validation, and outstanding items.
* Follow company approval processes for sensitive access, system changes, and releases.
* Coordinate priorities, feedback, and technical decisions with the Technology Manager and relevant specialists.

*Working Arrangement*

This is a full-time, remote position. Work is coordinated through weekly Agile planning, a shared task board, clear priorities, and review/QA before completion.

Final schedule, compensation, and engagement details will be discussed during the selection process.

Candidates must be available to work a full-time schedule aligned with U.S. Mountain Time (MT) business hours and collaborate with a U.S.-based team. Specific daily hours will be confirmed during hiring.

*How to Apply*

Please submit:

* A brief introduction describing your relevant technical experience.
* Two relevant, anonymized examples of applications, integrations, or automations you personally built or maintained; explain your role, testing approach, and measurable result.
* Your experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, including how you validate generated code and handle secrets or confidential data.
* Your full-time compensation expectations, earliest start date, country/time zone, and confirmation that you can work U.S. Mountain Time (MT) business hours.

Our priority is finding a reliable technical professional who can independently deliver quality work and grow with our technology initiatives.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:
* Flexible schedule
* Work from home



Application Question(s):
* Do you have hands-on experience developing and maintaining production web applications, including working with APIs, databases, and system integrations?
* Which AI-assisted coding tools have you used, and how do you review and test the code they generate?
* Do you have experience working with AppFolio, property-management software, or integrations involving similar business platforms?
* What are your compensation expectations for this full-time remote position? Please provide your expected rate in USD (hourly or monthly) and indicate whether it is negotiable.

Experience:
* professional web application development: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

title: Security Engineer, ML Infrastructure
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:
Higgsfield AI is looking for a highly technical, hands-on ML Security Engineer to join Higgsfield Security and own security across our GPU clusters and AI/ML infrastructure, from model training to inference and production deployment.

In this role, you will work as part of the Security team and closely with our ML and Infrastructure teams to design, implement, and operate security controls that protect models, data, and underlying infrastructure. Your core responsibilities will include securing GPU compute environments, assessing infrastructure and AI/ML vendors, and enforcing security requirements through technical controls, deployment policies, and verified remediation.

We're looking for someone who combines deep security engineering expertise with a practical, solutions-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across cloud environments, Kubernetes, Linux, and GPU infrastructure, and understands how to balance security, performance, and reliability in a fast-moving AI environment.

This role carries direct ownership of GPU infrastructure security and the security requirements that third-party providers must meet to support Higgsfield’s workloads and data.

What you'll do:
AI/ML & GPU Infrastructure Security

Own the security of GPU clusters supporting distributed training and production inference across cloud and rented datacenter environments.

Harden GPU hosts, operating systems, drivers, container runtimes, Kubernetes clusters, and workload scheduling configurations; reduce privileged access and unnecessary exposure.

Secure distributed training environments and GPU workloads through isolation, access controls, and data movement restrictions. Validate isolation between tenants and workloads across compute, networking, and storage, including shared GPU environments where applicable.

Design and implement controls to protect sensitive datasets, model checkpoints, weights, and customer data.

Strengthen inference security through tenant isolation, service authorization, secure model loading.

Partner with ML and Platform Engineering teams to integrate security into infrastructure design and development workflows.

Vendor Security Assessment & Enforcement

Lead technical security assessments of GPU infrastructure providers, datacenter operators, and other AI security vendors that process Higgsfield data and support AI workloads.

Evaluate vendor architecture and evidence covering tenant isolation, privileged access, data handling and retention, use of customer data for model training, encryption, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Translate security requirements into enforceable technical controls, including approved configurations, and continuous checks for configuration drift.

Track internal and vendor security findings to closure with accountable owners and deadlines, validate remediation, and escalate unmet requirements. Document any approved exceptions with compensating controls and expiration dates.

Cloud & Platform Security

Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Linux, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networks, and third party datacenter environments.

Secure infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and access to third-party infrastructure providers. Restrict and audit vendor and administrator access to cluster management interfaces and production systems.

Implement least-privilege access, workload identity, secrets management, encryption, and auditable access controls.

Identify and remediate vulnerabilities and configuration risks across production systems, including GPU hosts, drivers, and container runtimes, coordinating changes with infrastructure owners to maintain service reliability.

Security Operations & Risk Management

Develop and maintain detection and response capabilities for infrastructure and AI-specific security threats, including unauthorized GPU workloads, privilege escalation, and suspicious data transfers.

Investigate and respond to potential credential compromise, unauthorized data access, model theft, and compromised workloads.

Partner cross-functionally to implement practical security improvements that account for the performance, scalability, and reliability requirements of GPU workloads.

Requirements:

Strong hands-on experience in Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security, or a related technical discipline.

Deep understanding of Linux, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure security.

Practical experience securing or operating GPU clusters or distributed AI/ML infrastructure, with an understanding of training and inference workloads, GPU drivers and runtimes, and workload isolation.

Experience designing and implementing security controls across complex, distributed production environments.

Strong knowledge of identity and access management, workload isolation, encryption, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.

Experience conducting technical vendor security assessments, evaluating supporting evidence, and driving remediation with external providers.

Ability to identify, investigate, and remediate security vulnerabilities and infrastructure threats.

Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash.

Experience partnering with Infrastructure, Platform, or ML Engineering teams to implement security solutions.

Strong technical ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize security risks in a fast-paced environment.

A hands-on, collaborative approach with the ability to independently drive security initiatives from design through deployment, verify that controls work in production, and hold internal teams and vendors accountable for agreed security requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long-term growth.

Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $200,000 - $300,000, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location.

• Bonus: This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program.

Equity: In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks.

The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast-moving, and international team.

Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office three full days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams.

Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

title: Senior Software Engineer (Big Data)
description:
Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss.
Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis.

We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011
Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight
Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote

Position: Senior Software Engineer (Big Data)

Location: Remote - US Only (Preferred: Boston or Raleigh)

About the role:

Bitsight is looking for an experienced Big Data Engineer to join our engineering team. We pride ourselves in building exceptional career opportunities and offering outstanding benefits to our team. We have the enthusiasm of a start-up but the structure and solidity of a mature industry leader.

Bitsight’s mission is to make the online world a safer place by helping governments, companies and NGOs understand and mitigate their cybersecurity risks. Ours is an internet-scale challenge - we track every IP address, every piece of malware, and a good portion of the world’s internet traffic.

Bitsight’s data pipeline is the core of our Security Ratings product. We ingest security-related intelligence data from many sources, feed terabytes of data into a proprietary rating algorithm, and deliver ratings for over 1,000,000 organizations on a daily basis. Built on the highly scalable AWS ecosystem, our pipeline code base meets the highest standards of reliability and scalability to deliver consistent, actionable, intuitive, and responsive ratings to the customer.

We are looking for developers with a passion for building software to collect, aggregate, and analyze data at scale using continuous, incremental development methodologies. Working with a close-knit team across multiple locations, you will help us architect and evolve the pipeline to support even larger volumes via cloud data warehouses. You will bring actionable security insights to the customer through integrating new data sources, surfacing new features from existing data, and refining the rating algorithm. Collaborating with data science and research teams, you will build trust with Bitsight customers in the quality and integrity of our data.

Apart from domain skills, what we truly value are strong generalists: those with the critical thinking skills to use a variety of technologies and languages and pick up new concepts when needed. Strong collaboration skills are a must. We offer an opportunity to make a unique impact, not just as an individual but on the entire engineering team.

What We're Looking For:

Prior experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines
Strong proficiency in modern Java language programming
Strong computer science fundamentals in design, data structures, and algorithms
Experience working with a team of engineers, designers, and product owners in delivering a product to end-users
Excellent (English) written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Python
Experience with Hadoop, Spark ecosystems
Experience with Data Lakehouse tech stack (e.g., Apache Iceberg)
Experience with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch
Experience with CI/CD and Kubernetes
Experience with modern AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs)
Experience working in the IT security domain

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability.

Job Title: Software Engineer

Location: Colorado Springs, CO

Level: E4

Required Clearance Level: Top Secret/ SCI

Position Responsibilities:

Analyze real world data pertaining to Missile Defense and Space Domain Awareness.
As part of an Agile Scrum team, develop and complete features and stories mapped to program objectives.
Depending on the specific skills of the successful applicant, duties will include one or more of the following:
Collect and interpret real world data.
Develop new algorithms to effectively utilize the data.
Actively update current algorithms based on new data.

Basic Qualifications:

3+ years of related experience, may have a post- secondary degree or certifications in related discipline.
DoD Final Top Secret with SCI eligibility clearance at start.
The ideal candidate shall possess a strong analysis background, encompassing a broad range of disciplines that enable effective filtering of data to predict future states of ballistic missile threats. This background should include experience in performance analysis and characterization of large-scale complex system simulations, focusing on ballistic missile threats, weapon systems, and command and control architectures.
A knowledge of system engineering principles and practices is also required, including system design, development, testing, and evaluation, as applied to ballistic missile systems and associated command and control systems.
The candidate should also possess a working or theoretical knowledge of ballistic or non-ballistic missile defense concepts, including Battle Management and Command and Control (BM/C2) systems, defense communication systems, and the Missile Defense System (MDS).
A strong foundation in math and physics is required, as well as experience using tools such as MATLAB to support analysis of complex data.

Preferred Qualifications:

The candidate should possess data analytics skills, with the ability to collect, analyze, and filter large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform predictions of future ballistic missile threat states.
Furthermore, the candidate should have experience in analyzing and characterizing ballistic missile threats, including threat systems, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and the ability to predict future threat states based on trends and patterns.
Overall, the candidate should demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical disciplines that underpin ballistic missile threat analysis and prediction, including the ability to integrate and analyze data from diverse sources to inform predictive models and simulations.
Specific knowledge of one or more MDS elements, such as C2BMC, AN/TPY-2, LRDR, BOA, SBIRS, GMB, Aegis BMD, and PATRIOT, is highly desirable.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Lantern is building the AI-native operating system for the $9T wholesale distribution industry. Billions of dollars sit tied up in stock, yet most distributors still buy on gut feel and spreadsheets. You'll own the platform end to end, from data ingestion through training pipelines to inference and monitoring in production. 4–6 years as an ML or Software Engineer building ML systems in production.

BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Supply chain, logistics, demand forecasting, or operations-adjacent experience.

Time-series forecasting frameworks and traditional ML tools (XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn).

A founding-era, high-impact role at a hyper growth startup.

Own the ML platform that drives customer P&L on every account.

Make a massive positive impact across our entire supply chain and economy.

An office in San Francisco with a tight-knit founding team.

We hire operators who own outcomes, combining sharp judgment with pragmatic execution and a willingness to do the unglamorous work. Hard work, humility, customer obsession, and pride in a job well done: the values our customers live by, and the values we hire for.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI
description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead's RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead's corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

The Position

This is a newly created, green-field role and the first Forward Deployed Engineer, AI hired within the company. The person in this role will partner directly with business and scientific stakeholders across multiple functions to identify high-value problems and build and deploy AI-driven solutions that solve them. Because there is no existing playbook for this function, the Forward Deployed Engineer will help define how AI solutions are scoped, built, and delivered internally, working hands-on across the AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Microsoft technology stack alongside the Data Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Databricks/AWS platform teams. This role requires someone comfortable operating with ambiguity, moving quickly from problem discovery to a working solution, and embedding directly with internal teams to understand their workflows before proposing and shipping AI tools that fit how they actually work.

Responsibilities

Partner directly with stakeholders across R&D, clinical, manufacturing, commercial, and other business functions to identify, scope, and prioritize opportunities for AI-driven internal solutions.
Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows and applications that solve real operational and scientific problems, working end-to-end from prototype through production.
Establish foundational engineering practices, standards, and reusable patterns for AI solution delivery, since this is the first role of its kind in the organization.
Work closely with the Data Platform Engineer to access, model, and productionize data needed for AI solutions across Databricks and AWS.
Collaborate with the DevOps Engineer to build reliable CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and monitoring for AI applications across AWS/ Databricks inside a MS environments.
Leverage the Databricks platform and AWS services (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, S3) to build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows and applications, primarily by composing and integrating existing foundation models rather than training new ones.
Integrate solutions with Microsoft/Azure tools (e.g., Azure AI services, M365) where appropriate to meet business needs.
Rapidly prototype proof-of-concepts with internal teams, gather feedback, and iterate quickly to move validated solutions into production.
Document architecture, decisions, and delivery patterns to build a repeatable internal playbook for future forward-deployed engineering work.
Act as a hands-on technical resource embedded with business teams, translating ambiguous business problems into concrete technical solutions.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and deploying production-grade applications.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and Azure/Microsoft cloud services.
Experience working with Databricks, including data engineering, notebooks, and/or ML workflows.
Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, SQL, or similar) used for building data and AI applications.
Demonstrated experience building agentic workflows and applications with generative AI and LLM-based approaches (e.g., orchestration frameworks, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation) to solve practical business problems.
Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous, undefined environments and to build solutions from the ground up without an established playbook.
Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical business stakeholders and vice versa.

Preferred

Knowledge of the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry is desirable but not required.
Experience with Databricks certifications, AWS certifications, or Microsoft Azure certifications.
Prior experience in a "forward deployed engineer," solutions engineering, or embedded engineering role, working directly with business teams rather than in a purely centralized product function.
Experience with LLMOps/agent-ops tooling and practices for deploying, monitoring, and evaluating agentic workflows in production.
Familiarity with regulated-industry considerations (e.g., data privacy, validation, GxP) relevant to deploying AI solutions in a pharma environment.
Experience building internal tools, chatbots, or agentic AI applications using modern LLM frameworks.
A builder mindset with the initiative to define scope and process in a green-field function.

Arrowhead provides competitive salaries and an excellent benefit package.

AWS Generative AI & Machine Learning: Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations.

6+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS.

Consulting & Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C-level executives.
Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint.

Benefits

title: Senior Applied ML Algorithm Engineer
description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable technology collects rich physiological data, providing members with actionable insights into their recovery, training, and sleep.

We are seeking a Senior Applied ML Algorithm Engineer to develop and deploy signal processing algorithms and machine learning models that transform raw sensor data into accurate, reliable, and real-time physiological insights on WHOOP devices. In this hands-on role, you will own algorithm development from data analysis, model training, and Python prototyping through efficient C/C++ implementation, firmware integration, and production validation. Working closely with Data Science, Firmware, Hardware, and domain experts, you will deliver robust on-device algorithms that improve the member experience while meeting the power, memory, compute, and latency constraints of wearable hardware.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and develop algorithms that combine signal processing, feature extraction, and machine learning to derive meaningful physiological insights from wearable sensor data.

Analyze large-scale, noisy sensor datasets to train and evaluate models, identify performance gaps, and improve accuracy, robustness, and generalization across diverse members and real-world conditions.

Translate algorithm prototypes and trained models into production-ready C/C++ implementations, optimizing signal processing pipelines and on-device inference for accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency.

Partner closely with Firmware and Hardware teams to integrate algorithms into production firmware, validate execution on target hardware, and resolve differences between prototype and embedded performance.

Define performance metrics and rigorous validation plans, combining offline evaluation, lab-based experiments, real-world data analysis, and on-device testing to assess algorithm accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

Collaborate with Data Science, Software, Product, and domain experts to translate research findings into production-ready capabilities, investigate post-deployment performance gaps, and drive continuous algorithm improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of experience developing signal processing and machine learning algorithms for time-series or sensor data in real-world applications.

MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong foundation in digital and statistical signal processing for noisy time-series data. Experience with physiological signals or wearable sensors is a plus.

Proficiency in Python for data analysis, model development, and experimentation, and C/C++ for implementing efficient algorithms in embedded firmware.

Experience developing, training, and evaluating machine learning models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.

Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning models to resource-constrained embedded systems, including optimization across accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency.

Ability to independently investigate complex algorithmic problems, design rigorous validation experiments, and communicate technical tradeoffs with firmware, hardware, and data science partners.

Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company Description

Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity & revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC.

Role Description

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US-based) to join our team. This is a full-time, hybrid role with frequent hands-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams.

Product Description Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care.

Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch:

Design, train and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data.
Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs.
Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Nice to have

Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA-style models) or open-vocabulary detection.
Multi-object tracking and video analytics (re-identification, action recognition, temporal models).
Few-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low-data domains.
MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models.
Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance.

Key Components

Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications.
Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing.
Algorithm Implementation: Implement state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real-world scenarios.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems.
On-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected.
Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges.
Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Problem-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems.

The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state-of-the-art neural networks to make an impact.

Requirements

3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade-offs made along the way.
Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification.
Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation.
Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar).
Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure).
Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design.
Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non-ML stakeholders.

Benefits

Chooch offers extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

title: Software Engineering Manager (AI Quality)
description:

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Manufacturing
description:
About Positron

Positron AI develops custom hardware systems that accelerate AI inference, delivering step-function gains in performance per dollar and performance per watt over GPU-centric approaches. Our mission is to create the world’s best AI inference systems.

Position Overview

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Positron AI, you will own the mechanical, thermal-mechanical, and enclosure design of our AI inference platforms—from carrier-board mechanical integration and chassis design through rack-level packaging of our Asimov-based systems. You will ensure that the structural, thermal, and manufacturability characteristics of our high-power hardware meet the demands of high-density HPC and data center environments, and you will serve as the primary mechanical interface to our contract manufacturers and custom-part fabricators. This is a high-impact role requiring deep expertise in electromechanical design for high-performance electronic systems and the ability to drive designs from concept through volume production with external partners.

Key Responsibilities
Mechanical Design Ownership: Own the mechanical design of enclosures, chassis, and carrier-board mechanical integration for rack-mount (1U/2U) inference systems—including spatial studies, conceptual and detailed design, solid models, drawings, BOMs, and tolerance stack-up analysis.
Thermal & Structural Analysis: Lead thermal-mechanical and structural design and simulation for high-TDP ASIC platforms—heatsinks, cold plates, retention hardware, airflow, and shock/vibration—partnering with electrical and thermal teams to meet air- and liquid-cooled performance targets.
Manufacturer Engagement: Act as the primary mechanical lead and Positron representative for contract manufacturers, ODMs, and custom-part fabricators (sheet metal, injection molding, die casting, MIM, cable) through EVT, DVT, pilot, and production ramp.
DFx & Cost Reduction: Lead detailed DFM/DFA reviews—tolerances, assembly sequence, poka-yoke, part reduction and standardization, and DFMEA—to reduce unit cost and improve design robustness.
Fixtures & Packaging: Develop and qualify custom electromechanical fixtures supporting assembly and test, and own product packaging design, transit qualification, and implementation.
Validation & Governance: Own mechanical test-plan creation (structural, thermal, environmental), support EMC/EMI shielding and regulatory needs, and manage the mechanical risk register, ECOs, and technical escalations to keep programs on schedule for pilot and manufacturing ramps.
Required Qualifications
Experience: BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering and 7+ years designing electromechanical and enclosure hardware for high-performance electronic systems, spanning the full NPI lifecycle from concept through volume production.
Mechanical Design & Analysis: Proven expertise in 3D CAD (SolidWorks and/or Creo), detailed drawings and GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, and structural/thermal simulation (e.g., SolidWorks Simulation/Flow, Ansys).
Systems & Manufacturing: Experience with rack-mount or high-density electronic packaging, and direct experience selecting, qualifying, and managing custom-part suppliers and contract manufacturers—including global partners—through EVT/DVT/pilot phases.
DFx Discipline: Demonstrated track record applying DFM/DFA and FMEA to drive cost, quality, and manufacturability in high-volume or high-complexity production environments.
Collaboration: Strong ability to write clear mechanical specifications and communicate trade-offs across electrical, thermal, ASIC, firmware, and operations teams.
Preferred Qualifications
AI/ML or HPC Hardware: Background in mechanical and thermal design for AI/ML accelerators, servers, or other high-power data center hardware.
Advanced Thermal: Experience correlating CFD and thermal-mechanical simulations to real-world air- or liquid-cooled performance (heatsinks, cold plates, manifolds).
Compliance & Environmental: Experience driving hardware through EMC/EMI shielding, environmental qualification (shock, vibration, thermal), and packaging/transit testing; familiarity with FCC/CE and RoHS/REACH.
Credentials: Certifications such as Certified SolidWorks Professional, Ansys, DFMA, or packaging qualification (ISTA); relevant patents; and business/finance acumen (e.g., an MBA) connecting design decisions to cost and profitability.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Build groundbreaking AI hardware with a small, high-caliber team.

Competitive compensation (salary + equity) and comprehensive benefits.

title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Company Description

Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped.

This is a deeply hands-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure-primary with Databricks.

Responsibilities

Architecture Ownership and Direction

Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups.
Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning.
Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re-solving solved problems.
Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build-versus-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real-load latency.

Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture

Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re-embedding and versioning.
Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re-ranking; manage the recall-versus-precision and latency trade-off explicitly.
Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers.

Generative AI Portfolio

Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes.
Own the AI gateway and multi-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re-tested as the landscape shifts.
Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below.
Hold a clear, evidence-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever.

Agentic AI Portfolio

Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives.
Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts.
Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step-level tracing, regression testing, audit, and incident response.
Define the agent registry, tool catalog, memory and state services, and lifecycle from prototype to monitored production asset, and apply agentic patterns – spec-driven development, AI-assisted code and test generation – to our own engineering practice.

Governance, Trust and Security

Define responsible AI standards – bias/fairness testing, transparency, explainability, and human oversight on high-risk outputs – aligned with enterprise data governance policy rather than parallel to it.
Establish AI security patterns for prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreaks, and model/supply-chain risk; partner with the Data Governance team on classification, stewardship, certified sources, and access controls – Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, Unity Catalog, row-level security, PII handling, and retention.
Classify use cases by risk, drive attestation with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Risk, and lead third-party model/vendor technical review, translating findings into architecture constraints.

Observability, Economics and Platform Engineering

Instrument tracing, telemetry, and drift signals from day one so agent behavior is observable before it's questioned; build cost attribution and drive cost per successful answer as a first-class metric.
Contribute to the instrumentation that ties AI investment to measurable outcomes –partnering with platform and finance teams so unit economics are a first-class design constraint.
Define the Azure-native platform stack and lifecycle with MLOps and Engineering – Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, AKS, model/agent registry, CI/CD, landing-zone and environment strategy, Entra ID and network patterns, capacity, and LLMOps/AgentOps for versioning, promotion, and rollback.
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams on data readiness, certified metrics, lineage, and data contracts, and with Engineering on turning reference patterns into shipped services – defining the sanctioned builder environment so teams move fast without bypassing controls.

Technical Leadership

Raise the bar across Engineering and solution architecture through design reviews, system-level reasoning, and mentorship – driving rigor without direct reporting relationships.
Translate architecture trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior technology leaders and peer architects, and lead cross-team decisions with partners such as Microsoft, Databricks, strategic AI vendors, and systems integrators.
Write architecture decision records, reference patterns, and reusable accelerators, and develop proof-of-concept reference implementations that help teams move AI solutions from concept through production without rebuilding the controls.

Qualifications

Deep enterprise architecture and systems-design expertise. Proven ability to design end-to-end AI platforms spanning applications, models, data, APIs, integration, identity, infrastructure, and operations. Strong grounding in distributed systems, event-driven and service-oriented patterns, resilience, high availability, fault tolerance, and disciplined architectural decision-making.
Strong foundations in AI, machine learning, and generative AI. Deep understanding of classical ML, deep learning, NLP, foundation models, transformers, embeddings, semantic retrieval, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal AI, and agentic or multi-agent architectures, including when to use each approach, how to weigh the trade-offs, and where each one can fail.
Data, retrieval, and knowledge architecture expertise. Ability to design structured and unstructured data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text-to-SQL, multi-turn dialogue).
Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM-as-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles.
Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply-chain risk.
Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality-versus-performance trade-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale.
Business and value-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs.
End-to-end delivery with hands-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross-layer failures, and defend technical trade-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving.
Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike.
Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in retail, restaurant, e-commerce, or supply chain with high-volume, real-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

On-site in Longmont, Colorado. Monday through Friday, business hours, Mountain Time.

About Docketly

Docketly, a sister company to ABC Legal Services, is a fast-growing legal-tech company based in Longmont, Colorado. For the creditors' rights industry, we make hiring a stand-in attorney easy, fast, and reliable. We pair proprietary software with a nationwide network of attorneys.

Job Overview

You build and run the machine learning and analytics systems behind Docketly's operations. You build and run production models, from first idea to a live, monitored system on AWS. ABC Legal's data science team is your sounding board on methods. You build the BI reporting that leadership, operations, and client teams use daily. You support pricing and margin decisions with financial modeling. You work closely with backend engineers on data infrastructure and production issues. This role can grow into Senior Data Scientist as you take full ownership of the production model and the pricing roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Model development and MLOps

Build and run the full lifecycle of production ML models: framing, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment on AWS SageMaker (Model Registry, real-time endpoints), inference infrastructure (for example, AWS Lambda), and ongoing monitoring.
Build and maintain automated retraining and drift monitoring for deployed models.
Run staged production rollouts with holdout comparisons to prove model impact before full release. Review the test design with the team before launch.
Use AI coding tools to speed up analysis, modeling, and MLOps work.

Analytics, pricing, and reporting

Build and maintain the BI layer leadership relies on for exec reporting on revenue, margin, and volume, from dashboard design through data accuracy.
Run pricing and margin analysis for client accounts, including ad hoc investigations for named strategic accounts. Model the financial impact of proposed pricing changes before they go live.
Build and maintain rules-based pricing and case-difficulty logic by court and county, alongside statistical and ML approaches.
Build and tune large scoring and prioritization frameworks in Metabase, such as weighting, percentile scenarios, and drop-rate analysis, that drive daily operational decisions such as Hearing priority and assignment.
Turn ambiguous business questions into clear, well-scoped analyses.

Cross-functional partnership and documentation

Partner with engineering on data pipelines (AWS Glue, Lambda, EventBridge). Investigate and help resolve production database performance issues, such as ORM query patterns and indexing, alongside backend engineering.
Write down your methods and decisions in Confluence or an equivalent shared space, as you go, so other teams can find your reasoning and build on it without asking you directly.

Systems & Skills

Required

Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 3+ years of experience with applied statistics or machine learning.
Applied statistics: probability, hypothesis testing, and model evaluation across classification and regression/quantile models (for example, precision, recall, calibration, quantile coverage, and drift).
3+ years of experience with SQL and a relational database in a professional capacity. Docketly's production database runs on MySQL/Aurora, about 400 tables.
Python for data analysis and modeling: pandas, scikit-learn, and a gradient-boosting framework (XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost). Our production model uses CatBoost-based quantile regression.
Experience training and deploying at least one model to production, or on a cloud ML platform such as AWS SageMaker.
Metabase or comparable BI tooling.
Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

Staged production rollouts (canary or phased release) with holdout comparisons to prove model impact before full release.
AWS Glue, S3, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudFormation.
Comfortable using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to move faster on analysis and modeling work.
Experience diagnosing production database performance issues, such as query plans, indexing, and ORM-generated query patterns, in a large, high-table-count schema.
Software-engineering practices applied to ML code, such as automated testing with pytest, for production pipelines.

Benefits

Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) with Company Matching
Paid Time Off
7 Paid Company Holidays
4 Floating Holidays per Year
Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
Long-Term Disability
Health Care Reimbursement Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Pet Insurance

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM (Mountain Time) in Longmont, CO.

Salary Range: $110,000-$130,000 depending on experience

Application closing date: November 20, 2026, at 11:59pm

title: AI Engineer - Finance
description:

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:

BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.
