Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Company Description

Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped.

This is a deeply hands-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure-primary with Databricks.

Responsibilities

Architecture Ownership and Direction

Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups.
Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning.
Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re-solving solved problems.
Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build-versus-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real-load latency.

Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture

Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re-embedding and versioning.
Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re-ranking; manage the recall-versus-precision and latency trade-off explicitly.
Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers.

Generative AI Portfolio

Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes.
Own the AI gateway and multi-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re-tested as the landscape shifts.
Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below.
Hold a clear, evidence-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever.

Agentic AI Portfolio

Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives.
Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts.
Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step-level tracing, regression testing, audit, and incident response.
Define the agent registry, tool catalog, memory and state services, and lifecycle from prototype to monitored production asset, and apply agentic patterns – spec-driven development, AI-assisted code and test generation – to our own engineering practice.

Governance, Trust and Security

Define responsible AI standards – bias/fairness testing, transparency, explainability, and human oversight on high-risk outputs – aligned with enterprise data governance policy rather than parallel to it.
Establish AI security patterns for prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreaks, and model/supply-chain risk; partner with the Data Governance team on classification, stewardship, certified sources, and access controls – Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, Unity Catalog, row-level security, PII handling, and retention.
Classify use cases by risk, drive attestation with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Risk, and lead third-party model/vendor technical review, translating findings into architecture constraints.

Observability, Economics and Platform Engineering

Instrument tracing, telemetry, and drift signals from day one so agent behavior is observable before it's questioned; build cost attribution and drive cost per successful answer as a first-class metric.
Contribute to the instrumentation that ties AI investment to measurable outcomes –partnering with platform and finance teams so unit economics are a first-class design constraint.
Define the Azure-native platform stack and lifecycle with MLOps and Engineering – Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, AKS, model/agent registry, CI/CD, landing-zone and environment strategy, Entra ID and network patterns, capacity, and LLMOps/AgentOps for versioning, promotion, and rollback.
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams on data readiness, certified metrics, lineage, and data contracts, and with Engineering on turning reference patterns into shipped services – defining the sanctioned builder environment so teams move fast without bypassing controls.

Technical Leadership

Raise the bar across Engineering and solution architecture through design reviews, system-level reasoning, and mentorship – driving rigor without direct reporting relationships.
Translate architecture trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior technology leaders and peer architects, and lead cross-team decisions with partners such as Microsoft, Databricks, strategic AI vendors, and systems integrators.
Write architecture decision records, reference patterns, and reusable accelerators, and develop proof-of-concept reference implementations that help teams move AI solutions from concept through production without rebuilding the controls.

Qualifications

Deep enterprise architecture and systems-design expertise. Proven ability to design end-to-end AI platforms spanning applications, models, data, APIs, integration, identity, infrastructure, and operations. Strong grounding in distributed systems, event-driven and service-oriented patterns, resilience, high availability, fault tolerance, and disciplined architectural decision-making.
Strong foundations in AI, machine learning, and generative AI. Deep understanding of classical ML, deep learning, NLP, foundation models, transformers, embeddings, semantic retrieval, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal AI, and agentic or multi-agent architectures, including when to use each approach, how to weigh the trade-offs, and where each one can fail.
Data, retrieval, and knowledge architecture expertise. Ability to design structured and unstructured data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text-to-SQL, multi-turn dialogue).
Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM-as-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles.
Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply-chain risk.
Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality-versus-performance trade-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale.
Business and value-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs.
End-to-end delivery with hands-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross-layer failures, and defend technical trade-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving.
Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike.
Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP.
Experience in retail, restaurant, e-commerce, or supply chain with high-volume, real-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management.
Production multi-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU-accelerated serving stacks.
Contributions to open-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement.

Additional Information

Benefits:

No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
Childcare tuition discounts
No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs

Company bonus

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company Description

Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity & revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC.

Role Description

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US-based) to join our team. This is a full-time, hybrid role with frequent hands-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams.

Product Description Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care.

Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch:

Design, train and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data.
Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs.
Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Nice to have

Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA-style models) or open-vocabulary detection.
Multi-object tracking and video analytics (re-identification, action recognition, temporal models).
Few-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low-data domains.
MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models.
Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance.

Key Components

Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications.
Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing.
Algorithm Implementation: Implement state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real-world scenarios.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems.
On-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected.
Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges.
Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Problem-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems.

The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state-of-the-art neural networks to make an impact.

Requirements

3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade-offs made along the way.
Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification.
Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation.
Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar).
Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure).
Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design.
Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non-ML stakeholders.

title: Senior Scientist I, Cheminformatics
description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

Position

We seek a Senior Scientist with a demonstrated ability of successfully applying Cheminformatics and ML technologies to drive the discovery programs. You will collaborate closely with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, software engineers and machine learning experts to turn assay and structure-activity data into interpretable information for decision making. As an integral member of our Drug Discovery team, you will make a real and direct impact on accelerating the drug discovery process and ultimately benefiting patients.

About You

You're a cheminformatics expert who loves to solve difficult problems and are not discouraged by challenges. You have a passion for drug discovery and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You are curious, love challenges, and enjoy pushing the edge of technology to solve important problems with creative solutions. You're collaborative by nature, resourceful, open-minded, data-driven, and can operate with a sense of urgency.

What You'll Do

Develop and apply cheminformatics data-mining algorithms for the analysis of molecular modeling, virtual screening, and structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis.
Process and analyze chemical and biological datasets to evaluate properties such as drug-likeness, ADMET properties, dosing, etc.
Utilize molecular fingerprints, descriptors, and similarity metrics for compound clustering, classification, and regression.
Assist in development, maintenance, and monitoring of AI/ML models used for property prediction.
Optimize data pipelines for processing and storing chemical structures using cheminformatics toolkits (e.g., RDKit).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate computational approaches into curation and analysis workflows.
Maintain best practices in data integrity, reproducibility, and documentation of QSAR AI/ML models.
Provide guidance on the application of modern cheminformatics, ML/AI methods for library design (e.g. diversity, focused, fragment, DEL) and analyzing large datasets from HTS campaigns to building predictive models from them.
Routinely employ expert knowledge and analysis of SAR, physiochemical and ADMET properties.
Work alongside medicinal chemists to further triage emerging hits from HTS.
Collaborate closely with our data science team to integrate cutting edge AI/ML tools into our chemistry and drug discovery processes.

Qualifications

Ph.D. plus 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's plus 14 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's plus 16 years of relevant experience.
Expertise in cheminformatics data analysis, data mining, and machine learning models to solve drug discovery problems.
Expertise with ligand-based design approaches, QSAR, multiparameter optimization to rationalize SAR and design novel molecules.
Expertise in scientific programming languages such as python, with experience using RDKit and other cheminformatic libraries and data analytics (Spotfire, DataWarrior, D360).
Experience in virtual screening, HTS triaging, hit calling, and diversity analysis.
Familiar with commercial platforms and ELN/registration systems (Schrödinger, OpenEye, MOE, Dotmatics, DataBricks, KNIME).
A track record of publications, patents and/or conference presentations in computational chemistry and/or drug discovery.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic research environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex scientific concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Applied ML Algorithm Engineer
description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable technology collects rich physiological data, providing members with actionable insights into their recovery, training, and sleep.

We are seeking a Senior Applied ML Algorithm Engineer to develop and deploy signal processing algorithms and machine learning models that transform raw sensor data into accurate, reliable, and real-time physiological insights on WHOOP devices. In this hands-on role, you will own algorithm development from data analysis, model training, and Python prototyping through efficient C/C++ implementation, firmware integration, and production validation. Working closely with Data Science, Firmware, Hardware, and domain experts, you will deliver robust on-device algorithms that improve the member experience while meeting the power, memory, compute, and latency constraints of wearable hardware.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and develop algorithms that combine signal processing, feature extraction, and machine learning to derive meaningful physiological insights from wearable sensor data.

Analyze large-scale, noisy sensor datasets to train and evaluate models, identify performance gaps, and improve accuracy, robustness, and generalization across diverse members and real-world conditions.

Translate algorithm prototypes and trained models into production-ready C/C++ implementations, optimizing signal processing pipelines and on-device inference for accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency.

Partner closely with Firmware and Hardware teams to integrate algorithms into production firmware, validate execution on target hardware, and resolve differences between prototype and embedded performance.

Define performance metrics and rigorous validation plans, combining offline evaluation, lab-based experiments, real-world data analysis, and on-device testing to assess algorithm accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

Collaborate with Data Science, Software, Product, and domain experts to translate research findings into production-ready capabilities, investigate post-deployment performance gaps, and drive continuous algorithm improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of experience developing signal processing and machine learning algorithms for time-series or sensor data in real-world applications.

MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong foundation in digital and statistical signal processing for noisy time-series data. Experience with physiological signals or wearable sensors is a plus.

Proficiency in Python for data analysis, model development, and experimentation, and C/C++ for implementing efficient algorithms in embedded firmware.

Experience developing, training, and evaluating machine learning models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.

Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning models to resource-constrained embedded systems, including optimization across accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency.

Ability to independently investigate complex algorithmic problems, design rigorous validation experiments, and communicate technical tradeoffs with firmware, hardware, and data science partners.

Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

title: Senior Algorithm Validation Scientist
description:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking an Senior Algorithm Validation Scientist to join the Sensor Intelligence organization and help ensure our physiological sensing algorithms deliver accurate, equitable, and scientifically validated performance for our members. In this role, you will design rigorous statistical analyses and validation studies that evaluate algorithm performance throughout development and after deployment, translating complex real-world data into evidence that informs algorithm quality and product decisions. You’ll partner closely with scientists, engineers, and product teams to understand algorithm behavior, quantify uncertainty, identify opportunities for improvement, and help ensure members receive accurate and trustworthy insights.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and execute rigorous statistical analyses and validation studies to evaluate the accuracy, precision, reliability, robustness, and generalizability of physiological sensing algorithms against reference-standard measurements

Develop equivalence and non-inferiority analyses for hardware revisions, manufacturing changes, algorithm updates, and other changes that may affect the member experience, defining appropriate performance metrics, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and uncertainty estimates

Evaluate algorithm performance across demographic groups, physiological characteristics, environmental conditions, and behavioral contexts to identify performance differences, edge cases, and opportunities to improve algorithm quality and equity

Analyze experimental and observational production data to understand real-world algorithm behavior and draw defensible conclusions, applying approaches such as within-subject designs, difference-in-differences, matching, and other methods to account for confounding factors

Develop reproducible analysis workflows and automated validation processes that enable analyses to be consistently repeated across new cohorts, hardware revisions, and algorithm releases

Partner with Algorithm Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Scientists, and Software Engineers to design validation protocols, establish statistical best practices, communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences, and translate evidence into product improvements

QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Epidemiology, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience

3+ years of experience applying statistical methods to complex experimental or observational datasets, ideally within healthcare, medical devices, wearables, digital health, consumer technology, or a related field

Strong foundation in statistical inference, hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and validation study design; experience with equivalence, non-inferiority, causal inference, method-comparison, or related approaches is a plus

Proficiency analyzing large datasets using Python, R, or similar statistical programming tools, along with SQL and experience working with large-scale data environments

Experience with physiological, wearable, biomedical sensor, time-series, or longitudinal data; experience evaluating machine learning or signal processing algorithms is a plus

Familiarity with advanced statistical methodologies such as mixed-effects models, Bayesian statistics, survival analysis, fairness and parity analysis, or related approaches

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear conclusions and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

Evangelize Event-Driven Architecture

Demonstrate deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns, including publish/subscribe messaging, event sourcing, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), event streaming, and choreography vs. orchestration — applying these patterns to solve real customer architectural challenges.
Articulate the strategic business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences alike — connecting real-time event streaming to tangible outcomes such as reduced time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI-powered applications on a live data fabric.
Confidently position Solace Event Brokers against competing messaging and streaming technologies — including Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, and cloud-native brokers — articulating where Solace’s multi-protocol support, hybrid/multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS, and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation.
Challenge customers to evolve beyond request/response and batch architectures, guiding them through an EDA maturity model — from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a fully distributed, event-driven enterprise capable of supporting real-time AI and autonomous systems at scale.

Solace Agent Mesh Subject Matter Expert

Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI — bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
Demonstrate how Agent Mesh extends customers' existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI, reducing time-to-production for AI initiatives.
Articulate the platform's horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging, and governance capabilities to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
Engage use cases across industries — financial services, manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, defense and national security, and the public sector — where real-time event triggers drive autonomous AI agent actions.

Be the Broader Subject Matter Expert

Stay ahead of trends in event-driven architecture, agentic AI, cloud computing, messaging, and microservices.
Engage both technical teams and executive leadership, bridging the gap between technology and business outcomes.
Confidently position Solace in competitive landscapes, articulating differentiation and ROI across PubSub+ and Agent Mesh.

Collaboration & Customer Advocacy

Provide customer-driven insights to influence product roadmap decisions.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering to ensure customer success.
Serve as a field voice for Agent Mesh adoption, feeding real-world use cases and objections back to product and GTM teams.

Federal, DoD & Public Sector Engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across the U.S. Department of Defense (Department of War), the Intelligence Community, federal civilian agencies, and state, local, and education (SLED) customers, partnering with Account Executives, channel partners, primes, and systems integrators.
Translate mission requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as command and control, ISR and sensor data distribution, logistics and sustainment, cyber and situational awareness, and real-time citizen and agency services.
Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh, and Agent Mesh for disconnected, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth (DDIL) environments, edge-to-cloud deployments, and on-premises or air-gapped networks, including classified enclaves.
Speak credibly to federal security and compliance requirements, including FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, RMF and ATO processes, DoD Cloud Computing SRG impact levels (IL4/IL5), STIGs, FIPS 140 cryptography, and zero trust architecture.
Support government acquisition motions, including contributing to RFI and RFP responses, technical volumes, and compliance matrices, and working with program offices (PEOs/PMOs), contracting officers, and contract vehicles such as GSA Schedule, NASA SEWP, and partner-held vehicles.
Align Solace with DoD and federal modernization priorities such as JADC2, data mesh and data-centric architectures, open standards and modular open systems approaches (MOSA), and responsible AI adoption.
Enable and support partners, primes, and integrators so they can qualify, architect, and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.

Travel & On-Site Engagement

Expect up to 35% travel, primarily across North America, for on-site workshops, deal closures, and industry events, including customer sites, government facilities, and the Washington, DC area as needed.

About you

Technical & Business Acumen

You understand that real-time event streaming and agentic AI are strategic enablers for businesses, driving efficiency, responsiveness, and competitive differentiation.
You can clearly articulate the business value of Solace — tying technical solutions to real-world business challenges, from modernizing middleware to deploying production-grade AI agents.

Customer-Centric Mindset

You build strong, lasting relationships and know how to turn customers into long-term champions.
You're a proactive problem solver who takes ownership and drives initiatives forward.

Smart, Driven, and Adaptable

You thrive in fast-paced environments and continuously seek feedback to improve.
You're a clear communicator who tailors messaging for both technical and business audiences.
You bring energy, urgency, and enthusiasm to customer engagements, inspiring action and momentum.

Technical Expertise

Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or event streaming platforms (e.g., Solace PubSub+, Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or MQTT brokers).
Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks, LLM orchestration, and multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar).
Working knowledge of A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol) communication patterns is a strong plus.

Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and application integration patterns.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

Excellent presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel (up to 35%).
Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. Government customers, including DoD, the Intelligence Community, federal civilian agencies, or state and local government, in a technical sales, solutions, or systems engineering capacity (directly or through primes, integrators, or channel partners).

Preferred

Current or previously held U.S. security clearance at the Secret or Top Secret (TS/SCI) level. Active clearances are strongly preferred; a clearance that has lapsed or been held in the past is also valued. Candidates who are eligible to obtain a clearance are encouraged to apply.

Experience with DoD and federal mission systems and data architectures, such as C2, ISR, tactical edge, DDIL, and message-based or open-standards integration.

What Success Looks Like

Lead multiple successful PoVs — including Agent Mesh scenarios — and position yourself as a trusted advisor to customers.
Influence internal best practices and refine technical sales motions around agentic AI and Event Driven Architectures.
Lead at least one PoV or technical engagement with a DoD, federal, or public sector customer, including partner and prime enablement.

In 12 Months

Play a key role in closing multimillion-dollar deals, helping expand Solace's enterprise footprint.
Drive strategic adoption of event-driven architecture and Agent Mesh within enterprise customers, reinforcing Solace as the leader in real-time agentic AI infrastructure.
Help establish Solace as a recognized event-driven and agentic AI platform within the federal and DoD community, contributing to pursuits, partner-led wins, and reference architectures for government environments.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

title: Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Role description

Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer
Build agents on Agentforce, extend them with custom MCP servers, and ship both alongside the people who use them.
EXPERIENCE
6–9 years in Salesforce
What you’ll do
A Forward Deployed Engineer works where the business problem actually lives. You’ll embed with a business team, learn their process in enough detail to argue about edge cases, and then build the thing — in their org, against their data, with them watching. The feedback loop is days, not quarters.
The work is a mix of three things. First, Agentforce: designing agents, topics, and actions on the platform, grounding them in Data Cloud, and tuning them until they behave in production. Second, custom MCP servers you design and write in Python, which connect agents (Agentforce and others) to systems and capabilities the platform doesn’t cover out of the box. Third, the core Salesforce engineering that makes both dependable: Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and a data model that holds up under real volume.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Run discovery directly with business stakeholders — process walkthroughs, org audits, data profiling — and turn what you learn into a design, not a backlog of tickets.
Design, build, and deploy Agentforce agents: topics, instructions, guardrails, and actions backed by Apex, Flow, prompt templates, and APIs.
Ground agents in the right data using Data Cloud, retrieval, and the Einstein Trust Layer, with an eye on accuracy, latency, and cost.
Decide, case by case, whether a capability belongs in a native Agentforce action or a custom MCP server, and build the connection between them when it’s the latter.
Design and build custom MCP servers in Python that expose Salesforce objects, SOQL queries, Apex endpoints, and business actions as well-scoped agent tools, with clear input schemas, useful error messages, and permissions that respect the org’s sharing model.
Build on-platform: Apex (triggers, Queueable, Batch, async patterns), Lightning Web Components, Flow, Platform Events, and a data model you’d defend in review.
Integrate Salesforce with external systems — REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2.0 flows, Named Credentials, External Services, middleware — handling retries, idempotency, and rate limits properly.
Evaluate agent behavior end to end: write test cases, measure topic routing and action accuracy, and find failure modes before a user does.
Own deployment and quality — SFDX, scratch orgs, CI/CD, Apex test coverage that means something, and governor-limit awareness as a design habit rather than a bug fix.
Leave documentation and runbooks behind, so the team you embedded with can operate what you built after you move on.
REQUIREMENTS
Salesforce depth
6–9 years building on the Salesforce platform.
Production Apex at scale: bulkification, asynchronous patterns, governor limits, trigger frameworks.
Lightning Web Components and solid front-end fundamentals (JavaScript, HTML, CSS).
Declarative fluency — Flow, validation rules, sharing and visibility — and judgment about when not to write code.
Data modeling, large-data-volume considerations, and integration architecture.
Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud in production.
Agentforce, MCP, and Python
Hands-on Agentforce experience: building agents with topics and actions, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, and Data Cloud grounding.
Strong Python — you’ve shipped and maintained services, not just scripts.
Hands-on experience building custom MCP servers or comparable LLM tool-use integrations (function calling, agent frameworks, retrieval pipelines).
A working mental model of how LLMs fail, and the habit of designing tools that fail safely.
API design, authentication, and secrets handling in an environment with real compliance constraints.
Comfort with Git, CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment.
How you work
You’re effective in front of non-technical stakeholders — you can run the meeting, not just attend it.
You move under ambiguity and know which corners are safe to cut in a prototype and which ones aren’t.
You write clearly. Design docs, decision records, and handoff notes are part of the job.
BONUS
Salesforce certifications — Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud 360 Consultant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Integration Architect.
Production Agentforce deployments with measurable business outcomes.
Data Cloud implementation experience beyond basic grounding.
Open-source contributions to MCP servers, agent tooling, or the Salesforce developer ecosystem.
Prior consulting, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed work at a product company.
Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM applications.

Skills

title: Security Engineer
description:
About Qualitate

Qualitate is building the AI-native primary intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI-moderated interviews and insight synthesis – replacing weeks of manual research with hours of high-signal output.

Expert research is a broken industry dominated by legacy incumbents with expensive, manual, and slow services. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling expert calls, and synthesizing insights across fragmented providers. The process takes weeks to produce short-lived intelligence.

Qualitate transforms this workflow by autonomously conducting expert discussions at scale using AI. Qualitate’s AI Moderator interviews thousands of experts simultaneously each month, capturing forward-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real-time ROI signals. The platform turns these interviews into quantified, time-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms.

The Role

Join Qualitate as our first dedicated security engineer. At 45 people, the security program you build is the one the company will scale on. You’ll harden our cloud environment, build logging, monitoring, and detection, remediate findings from penetration tests, and serve as the security reviewer on design docs for new features and architecture changes. You’ll also lead ISO 27001 from start to finish: scoping, risk assessment, implementing controls, and getting us through the certification audit, with evidence collection automated instead of tracked in spreadsheets. This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be a part of our founding engineering team to define our security architecture and roadmap, and you’ll write and ship production code, not just review it.

Our customers are hedge funds, PE firms, and large enterprises with demanding security requirements, so the systems you secure and the certifications you earn directly shape how fast we grow. The problems are specific to our platform: protecting confidential expert interviews and customer research, securing an AI system that runs thousands of interviews a month, and reaching ISO 27001 without slowing engineering down. You’ll report to our CTO, lead our response when something goes wrong, and partner with our VP of Compliance and Legal on policy, customer security reviews, and our broader compliance program. We’re looking for someone with 4+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on compliance work, who thrives in fast-moving environments where the surface area is wide and the team is lean.

Who This Role Is For

4+ years of experience in security engineering. Ideally some of it at a startup or high-growth SaaS company where you secured cloud infrastructure hands-on and also helped build a compliance program.

Strong Cloud and infrastructure security skills. Experience securing AWS or GCP environments, including IAM, network security, logging and monitoring, secrets management, and encryption. You can read and write infrastructure-as-code.

Penetration testing rigor. You can contribute to a production code base and address issues raised in a penetration test.

ISO 27001 experience. You’ve helped take a company through ISO 27001 certification, including scoping the ISMS, running risk assessments, writing the Statement of Applicability, implementing controls, and managing the audit. SOC 2 Type II experience is a plus. [You’ve built the technical controls behind an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II certification, such as access management, logging, vulnerability management, and encryption, and automated evidence collection rather than tracking it in spreadsheets. Familiarity with ISMS scoping, risk assessments, or the Statement of Applicability is a plus.]

Fluent with AI models and agentic coding tools. You use AI in your daily workflow, understand the security and data governance risks of building with LLMs, and know how to defend against risks like prompt injection and data leakage. This is core to how we work.

High ownership, low ego. You work independently, communicate proactively, and don’t wait to be told what to build. You’re comfortable making architecture decisions and defending them in code review.

What Sets You Apart

Hands-on experience with security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, CSPM, and vulnerability or container image scanning, and with compliance automation platforms like Vanta or Drata. Bonus if you’ve built reusable guardrails or libraries that make the secure path the easy path for other engineers.

Experience securing LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including red-teaming AI features for prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse.

Experience building technical controls for data segregation and access, ideally in financial services or expert networks where MNPI and client confidentiality matter.

Security certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or OSCP.

Background in financial services and/or market research.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $160-220K base salary, based on experience.

Equity: Meaningful early-stage grant with upside tied to company growth.

Benefits: Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays.

Location: Full-time, in-person in New York City Mon-Weds, remote Thurs-Fri.

What to Expect Working at Qualitate

Excellence. You’ll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact.

High velocity. Fast-paced environment in terms of growth, decision-making, and time to impact.

High agency. Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out.

A builder’s mindset. You’ll create the processes, playbooks, and systems that define how this company scales.

Shared ambition. A small, early team disrupting the multi-billion dollar market research industry with AI.

Joy. We work hard and genuinely enjoy working together. Dedication to our work is matched only by our passion for fostering an enjoyable, collaborative work environment.

Qualitate is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

Ensora Health builds software that helps therapists and clinicians run successful practices, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape how we build it. You’ll bring deep PHP and object-oriented expertise, plus fresh ideas for using AI to change how our team designs, writes, tests, and ships code.

This isn’t a maintain-the-status-quo role. We want someone who looks at how we work with PHP today, says “here’s a better way,” and then proves it. You’ll lead technical projects, work directly with leadership to define requirements, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

What you’ll do

Lead the design, build, and deployment of features and services using object-oriented principles and modern PHP practices.
Challenge our current PHP patterns, tooling, and workflows, and champion improvements that make our code faster to ship, easier to maintain, and more secure.
Explore and prototype new ways to use AI in our development lifecycle, such as AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, test creation, code review, and root-cause analysis. Then turn what works into repeatable team practices.
Evaluate AI-assisted tools and set guidelines for using them responsibly, with human review, strong testing, and security standards.
Work with leadership and product partners to define software requirements and translate business needs into sound technical plans.
Take the lead on operational and technical projects, from scoping and estimation through delivery.
Shape architecture decisions, designing reusable, testable components that scale.
Diagnose and resolve complex bugs and performance issues, using logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes.
Drive automated testing, including unit and integration tests, and improve coverage across the codebase.
Lead by example in code reviews, give constructive feedback, and mentor engineers at every level.
Apply secure coding practices and address common web and application security risks before they become problems.
Keep technical documentation clear and current, using AI tools to help.
Share what you learn through demos, lunch-and-learns, and written guides, so the whole team benefits.

What you bring

Required

6+ years of professional software development experience in an object-oriented language, with deep PHP expertise.
Strong command of OOP principles, design patterns, and clean code practices.
A track record of improving how a team builds software, not only what it builds.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation, and sound judgment about when to trust their output and when not to.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3.
Solid experience with relational databases and SQL/MySQL.
Working knowledge of system architecture, debugging strategies, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
A demonstrated commitment to code quality, testing, and maintainable design.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.

Nice to have

Experience building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into PHP applications.
Experience creating repeatable AI workflows for your team, such as shared prompts, test generation, or automated review.
Experience with Docker or containerized environments.
Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
Experience in healthcare or other regulated software environments.
Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Ensora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community.

We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

Ensora Health is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
ISO New England is the independent system operator responsible for ensuring the safe and reliable flow of electricity in our region and planning for the future of the electric grid. We are at the forefront of New England's ongoing transition to clean energy.

ISO New England is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Analyst to support and enhance enterprise cloud, infrastructure, AI, and DevSecOps security initiatives. This role is responsible for advancing the organization's cybersecurity strategy by facilitating cross-functional collaboration to strengthen technical security, governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. The position provides technical leadership and cybersecurity expertise to support evolving business objectives while addressing emerging cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, AI, DevSecOps, and regulated environments. Working closely with internal stakeholders, the role drives security initiatives, influences technical decisions, and promotes a culture of security, resilience, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cloud security, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, AI security, network security and security compliance, with the ability to collaborate across technical teams to implement and maintain enterprise security standards

What we offer you:

A stable, mission-driven workplace where your impact truly matters
A highly engaged work environment that values inclusion, collaboration, and employee safety and wellbeing
Competitive compensation with a base salary + performance bonus
Robust benefits package, including:
Enhanced 401(k) and financial planning support
Tuition reimbursement and professional development
Wellness programs, including an onsite gym
Flexible work hours
Employee Business Networks
Free coffee at our onsite café
Hybrid work environment (3 days/week onsite)

How you will make an Impact

Develop and implement enterprise cybersecurity strategies aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Ensure compliance with cybersecurity frameworks and regulations including NERC CIP, NIST frameworks, CIS controls, FERC regulations, and SOC1/SOC2 requirements.
Implement enterprise security controls across cloud, infrastructure, applications, AI/ML environments, and regulated operational technology (OT) systems.
Conduct cloud security assessments across AWS and Azure environments, including IAM, CSPM, CIEM, container security, and configuration management.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

PrePass is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to architect, build, and scale our core data platform. In this role, you will lead the design of high-throughput data pipelines and lakehouse architectures while mentoring fellow engineers in modern software craftsmanship. We are looking for a technical leader who treats data engineering with the rigor of software engineering—relying on strict Test-Driven Development (TDD), extreme programming (XP) practices, and AI-augmented workflows to deliver reliable, observable, and mission-critical data systems in Databricks.

Key Responsibilities
Build & Scale Production ETL: Design, build, and operate scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on Azure that ingest, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources. Use advanced SQL, Apache Spark, and Lakehouse technologies such as Databricks and Delta Lake to support analytics, reporting, and real-time operational workloads.
Modernize Legacy Integrations: Partner with the team to define and execute a strategy for re-architecting legacy SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) workloads into modern, cloud-native pipelines. Lead proof-of-concept and prototyping work and turn the findings into clear recommendations.
Champion TDD & XP Practices: Lead by example in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using strict Test-Driven Development (TDD), pair programming, continuous refactoring, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
Drive AI-Augmented Engineering: Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, automate unit and data-quality test creation, streamline legacy refactoring, and enhance pipeline anomaly detection.
Own Production Reliability & Data Quality: Operate and monitor mission-critical data systems against strict SLAs for data freshness, uptime, and reliability. Diagnose and resolve integration and data-quality failures, build end-to-end traceability and observability, and tune pipeline and compute performance for cost and scalability.
Elevate Engineering Standards: Define and evolve team-wide data engineering standards, architectural documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives within an Agile environment.

Requirements

Qualifications
Senior-Level Data Engineering Experience: Proven track record of designing, building, and operating distributed data pipelines and cloud data platforms at scale.
Mastery of Test-Driven Development (TDD): Demonstrated hands-on expertise in TDD for data pipelines—writing unit, integration, and data-contract tests prior to implementation—alongside XP practices such as pairing, refactoring, and continuous integration.
AI Augmentation Proficiency: Practical experience integrating AI coding assistants and LLM-based tooling into daily engineering workflows to accelerate delivery, improve test coverage, and automate documentation.
Production Operations & Observability: Strong experience operating high-availability systems in production with clear uptime, reliability, and observability expectations.
Technical Leadership: Experience driving engineering standards, architectural reviews, documentation, and mentorship within an Agile team.

Bonus Points For

Experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, particularly in MLOps, model deployment, Feature Store management, or feature engineering on Databricks.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform / Bicep) for managing Databricks workspaces and cloud resources.
Familiarity of event driven architecture – queues, batches, and pub/sub models.
Databricks Expertise:Production experience with the Databricks platform (Delta Lake, PySpark/Spark SQL, Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog)
Background in high-volume IoT, telematics, or transportation industry data.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You
Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
401(k) plan with employer match.
