Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
Community Give-Back initiatives.
Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

title: GenAI Fullstack Engineer
description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled GenAI Fullstack Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

This position requires onsite 5 days/week

GenAI Fullstack Engineer | About the Role

As a GenAI Fullstack Engineer, you will design and build scalable enterprise applications that combine robust Java-based backend engineering with modern Generative AI capabilities. You will work across Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Python, FastAPI, LLMs, RAG, and Vector Databases to develop production-ready AI services and integrate them with enterprise applications. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who has expanded into hands-on GenAI engineering and can develop secure, scalable solutions spanning traditional backend services, AI orchestration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and LLM-powered applications.

GenAI Fullstack Engineer | Day-to-Day

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Security, and Spring Data/JPA.
Build and integrate production-grade GenAI and LLM applications, connecting AI services with existing Java/Spring Boot enterprise applications and business systems.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, semantic search, context retrieval, reranking, and response generation.
Develop AI services and orchestration components using Python and FastAPI, leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face to support reusable enterprise AI capabilities.
Implement and optimize Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, or ChromaDB to enable enterprise knowledge retrieval and semantic search.
Integrate LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Gemini, or Llama, applying prompt engineering, response evaluation, guardrails, and optimization techniques to improve solution accuracy and reliability.
Build secure and observable AI/backend services by implementing authentication, authorization, exception handling, logging, monitoring, API security, and production-grade engineering standards.
Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, collaborating with architects, data engineers, developers, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable GenAI solutions.

GenAI Fullstack Engineer | Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering 3+ years experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST APIs, including hands-on experience designing scalable and distributed enterprise backend applications.
Hands-on experience developing production GenAI/LLM applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, response evaluation, and enterprise AI use cases.
Strong production experience with RAG architectures, including embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, reranking, context construction, and RAG quality optimization.
Strong working knowledge of Python and FastAPI, with experience building AI/ML services and integrating Python-based AI components with Java/Spring Boot applications.
Hands-on experience with Vector Databases and GenAI frameworks, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face.
Experience with cloud and modern deployment practices, including AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production deployment of AI services.
Additional exposure to Agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI guardrails, LLMOps, Kubernetes, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, and event-driven microservices is advantageous.

title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Company Description

Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped.

This is a deeply hands-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure-primary with Databricks.

Responsibilities

Architecture Ownership and Direction

Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups.
Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning.
Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re-solving solved problems.
Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build-versus-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real-load latency.

Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture

Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re-embedding and versioning.
Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re-ranking; manage the recall-versus-precision and latency trade-off explicitly.
Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers.

Generative AI Portfolio

Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes.
Own the AI gateway and multi-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re-tested as the landscape shifts.
Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below.
Hold a clear, evidence-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever.

Agentic AI Portfolio

Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives.
Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts.
Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step-level tracing, regression testing, audit, and incident response.
Define the agent registry, tool catalog, memory and state services, and lifecycle from prototype to monitored production asset, and apply agentic patterns – spec-driven development, AI-assisted code and test generation – to our own engineering practice.

Governance, Trust and Security

Define responsible AI standards – bias/fairness testing, transparency, explainability, and human oversight on high-risk outputs – aligned with enterprise data governance policy rather than parallel to it.
Establish AI security patterns for prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreaks, and model/supply-chain risk; partner with the Data Governance team on classification, stewardship, certified sources, and access controls – Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, Unity Catalog, row-level security, PII handling, and retention.
Classify use cases by risk, drive attestation with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Risk, and lead third-party model/vendor technical review, translating findings into architecture constraints.

Observability, Economics and Platform Engineering

Instrument tracing, telemetry, and drift signals from day one so agent behavior is observable before it's questioned; build cost attribution and drive cost per successful answer as a first-class metric.
Contribute to the instrumentation that ties AI investment to measurable outcomes –partnering with platform and finance teams so unit economics are a first-class design constraint.
Define the Azure-native platform stack and lifecycle with MLOps and Engineering – Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, AKS, model/agent registry, CI/CD, landing-zone and environment strategy, Entra ID and network patterns, capacity, and LLMOps/AgentOps for versioning, promotion, and rollback.
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams on data readiness, certified metrics, lineage, and data contracts, and with Engineering on turning reference patterns into shipped services – defining the sanctioned builder environment so teams move fast without bypassing controls.

Technical Leadership

Raise the bar across Engineering and solution architecture through design reviews, system-level reasoning, and mentorship – driving rigor without direct reporting relationships.
Translate architecture trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior technology leaders and peer architects, and lead cross-team decisions with partners such as Microsoft, Databricks, strategic AI vendors, and systems integrators.
Write architecture decision records, reference patterns, and reusable accelerators, and develop proof-of-concept reference implementations that help teams move AI solutions from concept through production without rebuilding the controls.

Qualifications

Deep enterprise architecture and systems-design expertise. Proven ability to design end-to-end AI platforms spanning applications, models, data, APIs, integration, identity, infrastructure, and operations. Strong grounding in distributed systems, event-driven and service-oriented patterns, resilience, high availability, fault tolerance, and disciplined architectural decision-making.
Strong foundations in AI, machine learning, and generative AI. Deep understanding of classical ML, deep learning, NLP, foundation models, transformers, embeddings, semantic retrieval, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal AI, and agentic or multi-agent architectures, including when to use each approach, how to weigh the trade-offs, and where each one can fail.
Data, retrieval, and knowledge architecture expertise. Ability to design structured and unstructured data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text-to-SQL, multi-turn dialogue).
Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM-as-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles.
Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply-chain risk.
Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality-versus-performance trade-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale.
Business and value-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs.
End-to-end delivery with hands-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross-layer failures, and defend technical trade-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving.
Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike.
Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP.
Experience in retail, restaurant, e-commerce, or supply chain with high-volume, real-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management.
Production multi-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU-accelerated serving stacks.
Contributions to open-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement.

Additional Information

Benefits:

Paid Holidays and Vacation
Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
Childcare tuition discounts
No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
Fertility benefits
Adoption assistance
401k matching contributions
15% off the purchase price of stock
Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI
description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead's RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead's corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

The Position

This is a newly created, green-field role and the first Forward Deployed Engineer, AI hired within the company. The person in this role will partner directly with business and scientific stakeholders across multiple functions to identify high-value problems and build and deploy AI-driven solutions that solve them. Because there is no existing playbook for this function, the Forward Deployed Engineer will help define how AI solutions are scoped, built, and delivered internally, working hands-on across the AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Microsoft technology stack alongside the Data Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Databricks/AWS platform teams. This role requires someone comfortable operating with ambiguity, moving quickly from problem discovery to a working solution, and embedding directly with internal teams to understand their workflows before proposing and shipping AI tools that fit how they actually work.

Responsibilities

Partner directly with stakeholders across R&D, clinical, manufacturing, commercial, and other business functions to identify, scope, and prioritize opportunities for AI-driven internal solutions.
Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows and applications that solve real operational and scientific problems, working end-to-end from prototype through production.
Establish foundational engineering practices, standards, and reusable patterns for AI solution delivery, since this is the first role of its kind in the organization.
Work closely with the Data Platform Engineer to access, model, and productionize data needed for AI solutions across Databricks and AWS.
Collaborate with the DevOps Engineer to build reliable CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and monitoring for AI applications across AWS/ Databricks inside a MS environments.
Leverage the Databricks platform and AWS services (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, S3) to build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows and applications, primarily by composing and integrating existing foundation models rather than training new ones.
Integrate solutions with Microsoft/Azure tools (e.g., Azure AI services, M365) where appropriate to meet business needs.
Rapidly prototype proof-of-concepts with internal teams, gather feedback, and iterate quickly to move validated solutions into production.
Document architecture, decisions, and delivery patterns to build a repeatable internal playbook for future forward-deployed engineering work.
Act as a hands-on technical resource embedded with business teams, translating ambiguous business problems into concrete technical solutions.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and deploying production-grade applications.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and Azure/Microsoft cloud services.
Experience working with Databricks, including data engineering, notebooks, and/or ML workflows.
Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, SQL, or similar) used for building data and AI applications.
Demonstrated experience building agentic workflows and applications with generative AI and LLM-based approaches (e.g., orchestration frameworks, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation) to solve practical business problems.
Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous, undefined environments and to build solutions from the ground up without an established playbook.
Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical business stakeholders and vice versa.

Preferred

Knowledge of the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry is desirable but not required.
Experience with Databricks certifications, AWS certifications, or Microsoft Azure certifications.
Prior experience in a "forward deployed engineer," solutions engineering, or embedded engineering role, working directly with business teams rather than in a purely centralized product function.
Experience with LLMOps/agent-ops tooling and practices for deploying, monitoring, and evaluating agentic workflows in production.

title: Sr. SW Engineer (Full Stack)
description:

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Job Description

Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 80–90% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain full stack features across React/JavaScript/TypeScript front ends and Java/Spring Boot and Node.js back-end services, owning delivery from requirement through production.

- Build and ship production solutions using agentic AI — LLM-backed services, tool-calling and multi-step agents, MCP servers and clients, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, prompt and context engineering, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails for safety, cost, and latency.

title: AI Engineer - Finance
description:
Job Description:
The AI Engineer - Finance is an embedded AI partner within Lineage's Finance organization, the professional who sits at the intersection of the AI platform and finance and accounting problems. Reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer and working directly with the broader finance team, this role works with the finance team to identify high-value AI finance use cases, builds first solutions alongside finance teams where needed, and teaches those teams to build, run, and improve their own, so capability stays in Finance. These AI solutions will make our finance professionals more productive and make our processes more accurate, efficient, and well controlled. Success is measured by team adoption and self-sufficiency, not solely by solutions delivered. The role has a dotted-line relationship to a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer in Lineage's enterprise AI Center of Excellence (CoE) and builds/teaches in accordance with the standards, platforms, and governance established by the AI CoE.
This is a REMOTE role.
We are unable to sponsor work authorization, now or in the future, for this role.

Primary Responsibilities:

Partner and discover: Embed with Finance and Accounting stakeholders (e.g., controllership, financial reporting, FP&A, tax, audit, and treasury) to deeply understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement.
Grow and maintain a broad and deep knowledge of finance and accounting processes, Lineage's supply chain business, and the ways AI can be applied to them.
Teach and enable: Enable and upskill Finance team members to adopt AI tools effectively and identify new opportunities for AI-driven improvement.
Work with CAO and other finance leaders for ideas including, but not limited to, workshops, holding office hours, reusable guides and templates, champion network, hosting a hack-a-thon, etc. Coach teams to build and own their own solutions, and move from "building for" to "building with" over time.

This includes identifying "quick wins" and situations where a short-term solution will provide benefit while a longer-term solution maybe developed in the future. Additionally, work with teams in existing systems, including those that leverage AI, to further leverage existing functionality and supplement with additional prompts, skills, and/or agents, as needed.
Identify places where AI solutions require a broader skillset and then sScope, architect, and deliver end-to-end AI solutions, from data ingestion, prompt engineering, skill and agent build through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
Govern and control: Provide software engineering and AI solutions excellence including:
Leverage the CoE's core AI platform, working closely with Platform Engineers to extend tooling and surface platform gaps.
Follow and apply the AI CoE's standards for architecture, development, security, data governance, model evaluation, and responsible AI; partner with the dotted-line Senior Forward Deployed Engineer on design and code reviews, technical guidance, and alignment with enterprise AI priorities.
Ship flagship finance use cases (e.g., month-end close, account reconciliations, journal entry support, variance analysis, and reporting) that establish repeatable delivery patterns.
Design solutions that support internal controls, auditability, and SOX compliance, including appropriate human review, documentation, and data access controls.
Measure and scale: Help the finance team quantify value, potential cost savings, and track adoption/self-sufficiency metrics.
Other Technical Objectives:
Partner with Solutions Architects and Data & Integration Engineers to ensure solutions integrate cleanly with enterprise systems and finance data sources (e.g., ERP, consolidation, and reporting systems).

Education and Work Experience:

Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise), or other similar tools is a plus.
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern AI/ML tooling (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, vector databases, RAG pipelines).
Demonstrated ability to take a project from an ambiguous business need to a production-grade solution with minimal oversight.
Experience working in fast-paced, early-stage, or consulting-style environments where scope and priorities shift frequently.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern data infrastructure.
Track record of shipping AI/ML use cases in enterprise environments (financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, or similar) is a plus.
Experience building with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) and evaluating model outputs systematically is a plus.
Previous exposure to finance and accounting systems (e.g., ERP, general ledger, consolidation, close management, and reporting tools) is a plus.
Understanding of accounting principles (U.S. GAAP), the financial close process, and internal controls (SOX) is a plus.

Manage stakeholder relationships and expectations across multiple engagements.

Manage multiple assignments / projects simultaneously.

title: Sr. Principal UX Engineer
description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation's interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Principal UI/UX Designer to own user experience and interface design inside an Extreme Programming (XP) product team. User research is the heart of this role: you will spend a substantial share of your time with users, running interviews, observation and usability testing, and turning what you learn into designs you ship with engineers every iteration.

Rapid Capabilities is the product development org at Clarity Innovations. A lean team of engineers builds and maintains the company's flagship product suites, Aurora Enterprise and Manifest, and sets the practices for all capability development company-wide. This role is the org's dedicated UX owner, working closely with the Chief Product Manager and engineering leads.

What you'll do
Lead continuous user research as an ongoing part of the job, not a one-time phase: plan and run user interviews, contextual inquiry, field observation and usability tests every iteration.
Build and keep direct, recurring access to users and customer stakeholders, including expert and operational users.
Synthesize findings into personas, journey maps, jobs-to-be-done and opportunity areas the team uses to set priorities.
Turn research into testable hypotheses and user stories with clear UX acceptance criteria, working with the product manager.
Validate designs with real users before and after release; track usability measures (task success, time on task, SUS) and feed results into the backlog.
Make research a team sport: bring engineers into interviews and test sessions, and keep a shared, searchable research repository.
Use AI tools to speed up the design process: synthesizing interview notes and transcripts, drafting research plans and scripts, exploring design variations, and generating working prototypes, while keeping human judgment and real user evidence at the center.
Apply design principles to Department of War (DoW) mission contexts: design for operators and analysts making high-stakes decisions under time pressure, with dense information, in degraded or disconnected environments, and within security and accreditation constraints.
Own end-to-end UX for one or more product areas: flows, information architecture, interaction design and visual UI.
Work as a full member of the XP team: join planning, stand-ups and retrospectives, and pair with engineers on implementation details daily.
Break design work into thin, shippable slices that fit one iteration, rather than delivering large up-front specs.
Prototype quickly (low to high fidelity) to test ideas with users before and during development.
Build and maintain a shared design system and component library with engineering, so UI stays consistent across Aurora Enterprise and Manifest.
Champion accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA or later, Section 508) and usability for complex, data-heavy enterprise and mission workflows.
Required qualifications
5+ years of professional UI/UX or product design experience, with a portfolio that includes research case studies showing how findings changed product direction.
Deep hands-on experience planning, conducting and synthesizing both generative and evaluative research: user interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing and surveys.
Skilled interviewer: asks neutral, open questions, listens actively, and builds rapport with both expert and non-technical users.
Ability to recruit participants and sustain a regular research cadence within short development iterations.
Experience designing enterprise, analytics or data-intensive applications (dashboards, maps, complex forms, workflows).
Practical experience using AI tools (e.g. LLM assistants, AI features in design tools, AI prototyping tools) to speed up research synthesis, ideation and prototyping, with sound judgment about their limits, bias and data-handling risks.
Understanding of DoW use cases (e.g. command and control, intelligence analysis, mission planning, logistics, geospatial workflows) and how core design principles apply there: situational awareness, cognitive load, error prevention, trust in automation, and clarity under stress.
At least 2 years working as an embedded designer on an XP team (pair programming, TDD, short iterations, continuous integration), or a closely equivalent agile practice.
Demonstrated ability to deliver design incrementally and adjust based on feedback from working software.
Strong interaction design, information architecture and visual design skills.
Fluency in a modern design and prototyping tool (e.g. Figma).
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and component-based front-end frameworks, enough to pair productively with engineers.
Clear communication, including presenting research findings persuasively to engineers, product managers and executives.
Preferred qualifications
Formal training or a degree in HCI, human factors, cognitive psychology, anthropology or a related field.
Experience researching with hard-to-reach users (operators, analysts, field personnel) or in restricted environments.
Experience with quantitative methods: product analytics, survey design, A/B testing.
Experience setting up research operations: participant panels, consent processes, research repositories.
Experience creating or scaling a design system used by multiple products.
Familiarity with Lean UX, design studios, or story mapping.
Ability to contribute front-end code directly (e.g. React, TypeScript, CSS).
Experience designing AI-assisted or LLM-powered interfaces.
Direct experience on DoW programs, including research with warfighters, operators or analysts in mission or exercise settings.
Active security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one (if required for the position).
IC4 level expectations

At IC4 you are a senior individual contributor who works independently and raises the design bar for the teams around you.

Dimension

Expectation

Scope

Owns UX for a full product area or product suite, not just individual features

Research

Sets the research agenda for that area, chooses methods, and keeps a regular cadence of direct user contact

Autonomy

Sets own research and design direction; needs little day-to-day guidance

Influence

Uses research evidence to shape roadmap and backlog decisions with product and engineering leads

Quality

Defines UX standards and design system patterns others follow

Mentorship

Coaches engineers and junior designers on research and usability practice

Ambiguity

Turns unclear customer problems into testable design hypotheses

How we work

Our teams practice XP, and design is part of the team rather than a hand-off before it.

Research every iteration: the team talks to users each cycle, and what we learn drives the backlog.
Short iterations: design, build and review in one- to two-week cycles.
Pairing: designers pair with engineers on UI implementation and with product on story writing.
Whole team: design, product and engineering plan, estimate, sit in on user sessions, and retro together.
Small releases: ship thin slices to users often and learn from real usage.
Sustainable pace: steady, predictable delivery over heroics.

Salary Range: $93,000 - $255,000

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.

Background in distribution, supply chain, or another B2B business.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Staff Software Engineer, Data Ingestion Platform

About the Role

We are excited to welcome a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to our Data Movement and Transformation team within the Data organization! In this role, you will help design and operate the paved-path platform that empowers product engineering, analytics, data science, and business teams to move and transform data seamlessly and reliably across Realtor.com.

Our team champions foundational capabilities spanning real-time streaming, batch ingestion, data replication, orchestration, transformation, schemas, connectors, platform libraries, observability, and developer self-service. We are looking for a collaborative engineer who thrives across platform infrastructure and developer-facing tooling, takes pride in production outcomes, and makes it effortless for teams to onboard and operate data workflows.

Team platform charter

We are dedicated to building managed, highly reusable paths for:

Real-time and batch data ingestion through Prism/Data Collector and related APIs.
Kafka-based streaming on AWS Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK), including topics, producers, consumers, Kafka Connect, KSQL, and streaming integrations.
Data contracts and schema governance using Avro and Schema Registry, including compatibility, validation, and lineage metadata.
External-system replication and integration through Fivetran and Kafka Connect, including secure connection management and operational support.
Scheduled and batch workflows through Apache Airflow on AWS Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA).
Data transformation and modeling through dbt, including integration with Airflow, Snowflake, and the data catalog.
Snowflake lakehouse access patterns, data exports, reusable toolsets, and platform libraries.
Observability, alerting, incident response, pipeline health checks, and self-service troubleshooting across ingestion, streaming, connectors, Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake.
Documentation, onboarding, paved paths, reference implementations, and developer experiences that help teams adopt the platform without bespoke support

We focus on crafting and operating shared capabilities and reference tooling. Rather than building each team's custom producer, consumer, connector, or dbt model directly, we delight in empowering teams with the platform, guardrails, templates, libraries, and guidance they need to build safely and efficiently!

What You'll Do

Platform engineering

Design, build, and operate scalable ingestion, streaming, replication, orchestration, and transformation capabilities used by many teams.
Develop and improve platform APIs, services, libraries, templates, and paved paths for streaming, batch, bulk, and external data ingestion
Build and maintain ingestion APIs and client libraries in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Python, supporting streaming, batch, bulk, and external data-ingestion use cases.
Operate and evolve Kafka/MSK infrastructure, including topics, partitions, replication, retention, throughput, consumer groups, access controls, and upgrades.
Support Kafka Connect and sink integrations for systems such as Snowflake, S3, New Relic, and Elasticsearch; improve connector reliability, provisioning, and troubleshooting.
Build and maintain Schema Registry and Avro-based data contract workflows, including schema validation, compatibility, versioning, and safe evolution.
Build and maintain KSQL or equivalent near-real-time transformation patterns where appropriate.
Improve Airflow/MWAA orchestration patterns, DAG templates, scheduling, backfills, retries, dependency management, and operational reliability.
Improve dbt platform capabilities, including project conventions, macros, testing, materializations, restricted-data patterns, and Airflow integration.
Develop reusable TypeScript, Python, and/or Kotlin libraries and reference implementations for producing, consuming, validating, and moving data.
Contribute to Snowflake integration patterns, data exports, toolsets, and secure access paths without taking ownership of stakeholder-specific data modeling.

Reliability, security, and operations

Take pride in ensuring delivery, quality, availability, low latency, cost efficiency, and operational reliability for our platform capabilities.
Instrument systems with actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, runbooks, and service-level objectives.
Diagnose data issues across the full path from source to serialization, topic, connector, and Snowflake destination.
Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, post-incident improvements, and production support rotations.
Apply least-privilege access, environment separation, secrets management, auditability, and secure-by-default platform design.
Improve platform health monitoring and standardize operational workflows across Fivetran, Kafka/MSK, Airflow, dbt, connectors, and Snowflake.
Balance reliability, delivery speed, developer experience, operational simplicity, and cost when making architecture decisions.

Developer experience and enablement

Create clear onboarding paths, templates, examples, documentation, and diagnostics that help teams self-serve.
Partner closely with internal users to understand their ingestion and transformation needs and guide them to the appropriate platform path.
Improve discoverability, lineage, data contracts, and metadata through integration with the data catalog.
Clearly communicate technical requirements, tradeoffs, operating boundaries, and migration plans to engineers and stakeholders.
Inspire and mentor fellow engineers, raising the technical bar through constructive design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

AI-assisted engineering and agentic automation

Create practical agentic workflows that automate repetitive platform and developer-support work, such as onboarding, schema validation, DAG and dbt scaffolding, connector checks, pipeline diagnostics, incident triage, and documentation updates.
Build reusable AI skills, tools, and workflows that interact with platform APIs, repositories, tickets, observability systems, and documentation while preserving appropriate access controls.
Design grounded AI experiences that use authoritative platform knowledge, return structured findings, cite or link to source documentation, and escalate safely when confidence is low.
Develop agents that can reason across pipeline boundaries, correlate evidence, identify likely failure points, and produce concise remediation guidance or actionable tickets.
Add automated checks and evaluation harnesses for agent behavior, including correctness, safety, permissions, tool-use reliability, hallucination resistance, and regression testing.
Use AI to improve engineering throughput without weakening review, change-management, production-safety, or data-governance controls.
Contribute reusable patterns for prompt/context design, tool calling, workflow orchestration, human approval, audit logging, and continuous improvement of AI-enabled platform operations.

What You'll Bring

8+ years of experience building backend infrastructure, APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, or developer tooling; equivalent experience is acceptable.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
Strong experience with event-driven systems and Kafka, including topics, partitions, consumer groups, delivery semantics, schema evolution, and operational troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure supporting data platforms; experience with MSK, MWAA, IAM, networking, monitoring, and managed services is highly valuable.
Experience operating one or more of Fivetran, Kafka Connect, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Schema Registry, KSQL, or comparable platforms in production.
Strong understanding of data ingestion, replication, orchestration, transformation, data contracts, lineage, observability, and pipeline reliability.
Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, or another production backend language; the ability to work across more than one language is preferred.
Experience designing and supporting APIs, libraries, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with Avro or another schema and serialization system, data quality controls, compatibility management, and event-driven design.
Demonstrated ability to debug complex failures across distributed systems and communicate the diagnosis clearly.
Strong security instincts, including least privilege, secrets management, environment isolation, audit trails, and safe handling of restricted data.
Ability to document technical requirements and operating procedures so that other teams can successfully use the platform.
Ability to lead initiatives, make sound tradeoffs, and work effectively with product engineering, analytics, data science, security, and infrastructure partners.
Practical experience creating AI-assisted developer workflows, agentic automation, reusable AI skills, or tool-using LLM applications.
Understanding of AI safety and reliability practices, including grounded retrieval, permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals, observability, evaluation, and controlled production rollout.
Experience with Kafka/MSK upgrades, capacity planning, performance tuning, or multi-environment operations.
Experience building self-service platform products, internal developer platforms, or paved paths.
Experience with data observability, lineage, data contracts, incident automation, or support-ticket automation.
Experience with one or more of TypeScript, Python, and Kotlin client libraries or SDKs.

Working style

Enthusiastically own outcomes end to end, from design through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational support.
Prefer reusable platform capabilities over one-off solutions.
Enjoy collaborating directly with end-users to understand and support their requirements and use cases.
Make tradeoffs explicit and optimize for reliability, security, simplicity, and user impact.
Collaborate openly, ask clarifying questions early, and communicate risks before they become incidents.
Treat production safety and data governance as requirements, not afterthoughts.

How We Work:

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You:

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:

Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location

Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®
Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

title: Data Platform Engineering Manager
description:
Berkshire Hathaway Homestate Companies, Workers Compensation Division, is looking for a Data Platform Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for the organization's enterprise data platform and is accountable for its performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency. This individual oversees the selection, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the technologies that store, process, and move data across the organization.

The position requires broad expertise across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data platforms, with responsibility for developing and strengthening these capabilities within the team. The Manager leads day-to-day platform operations, including 24x7 support and incident response, and ensures delivery through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices aligned with the Autonomous Composable Development (ACD) model.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
TEAM LEADERSHIP AND DEVELOPMENT
Directly supervises Database engineers day-to-day direction, workload prioritization, performance management, 1:1s, and reviews aligned to the IC level framework.
Accountable for developing the team’s depth across relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms, and for raising automation, IaC, and GitOps proficiency.
Accountable for closing the gap between defined standards and demonstrated team practice.
Manages on-call rotation scheduling and escalation coverage.
Surfaces risks, gaps, and disagreements in writing at the time they are identified rather than after work is underway.
Resolves cross-team blockers directly with peer leaders and escalates only what cannot be settled at that level.
DATA PLATFORM OWNERSHIP
Owns the operational data store estate: OLTP and NoSQL across MS SQL, Cosmos, and equivalents. Recommends the right store for a given workload rather than defaulting to a single engine.
Owns transformation and data movement: ADF, Airflow, and the replacement of the HVR and SSIS approaches currently in place.
Operates the analytical data platform — OneLake and the Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers — to the same standards as the relational estate.
Selects technology within each category, and is accountable for the reliability, performance, and cost of what is chosen.
Manages data platform cost, licensing, and capacity per organizational guidelines.
AUTOMATION AND DELIVERY
Defines standards for GitOps schema management, IaC provisioning, and lifecycle automation. Authors and reviews T-SQL, PowerShell, and IaC templates (Terraform, Azure DevOps) for database provisioning and schema deployment.
Accountable for moving the team’s work from manual execution to self-service — including database change management through Liquibase or equivalent tooling, and the automation of environment refreshes.
Responsible for the team’s participation in cross-team automation initiatives, including timely delivery of post-configuration requirements, provisioning inputs, and integration constraints to partner engineering teams.
Champions Claude and LLM tooling for schema documentation, data lineage, query optimization, and automation; mentors engineers on advanced usage.
DATABASE OPERATIONS, RESILIENCE AND PERFORMANCE
Remains hands-on in the design, implementation, and administration of the data platform estate — Azure SQL, Managed Instance, SQL Server, and the relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms adopted over time. Serves as the final technical escalation point for complex incidents.
Owns redundancy planning, high availability design, and failover execution across the estate, including Always On availability groups, geo-replication, and tested failover procedures. Validates HA/DR through regular testing and drives remediation of single points of failure.
Defines monitoring standards on Dynatrace and oversees performance, availability, and capacity monitoring across the data platform estate. Leads complex performance tuning and bottleneck resolution.
Participates in the 24x7 on-call rotation. Reviews post-incident reports and drives remediation to closure.
STANDARDS, COMPLIANCE AND CROSS-TEAM LEADERSHIP
Implements and enforces enterprise data classification, PII handling, retention, and audit compliance requirements within the data platform estate; partners with Security on data security aligned with NYDFS Part 500 and SOC requirements.
Ensures team adherence to documentation and change management standards; reviews and approves change records before implementation.
Leads tooling evaluations and vendor assessments; coordinates with the Director on capacity planning, budgeting, and staffing.
Represents the data platform in cross-functional work with DevOps, Application Engineering, Security, and Analytics, and resolves technical boundaries between teams directly.
Communicates technology trade-offs and platform risk to Director and VP levels; authors proposals for investments involving significant budget or operational risk.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION, LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related discipline required. Master’s preferred.
Two or more strongly preferred: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300). Equivalent certifications in non-Microsoft data platforms are equally valued.
EXPERIENCE
10+ years in database administration, data engineering, or data platform operations.
5+ years in a team lead, supervisory, or management role with direct people-management responsibility.
Hands-on experience across more than one database platform — required. Depth in SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Managed Instance, plus working experience with at least one of Postgres, MySQL, Cosmos, or Mongo.
Database redundancy and high availability (Always On, geo-replication, or equivalent).
Cloud data platform experience (Azure SQL, Fabric, or Databricks) and ETL/ELT.
IaC and automation tooling (Terraform, Azure DevOps, PowerShell). Experience automating database provisioning and schema deployment.
Clause or LLM usage for data engineering preferred.
Track record designing and operating data systems in regulated industries preferred.
TECHNICAL/FUNCTIONAL KNOWLEDGE
Expert-level SQL Server 2016–2022, Azure SQL, and Managed Instance. Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.
Familiarity with relational and NoSQL platforms beyond the Microsoft stack — Postgres, MySQL, Cosmos, Mongo — sufficient to evaluate and recommend the right store for a given workload.
ETL/ELT patterns and tooling (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Fabric pipelines, HVR, Databricks) and medallion and lakehouse patterns.
Terraform, Azure DevOps, Git-based workflows, PowerShell, and Python. Repository and GitOps fluency sufficient to review and direct the team’s IaC contributions.
Dynatrace monitoring. Advanced Claude/LLM usage for data engineering and automation.
NYDFS Part 500, SOC audit compliance, and PII handling.
LANGUAGE ABILITY AND COMMUNICATION
Presents technology decisions and trade-offs to Director, VP, and Analytics leadership.
Authors standards, runbooks, change records, performance feedback, and investment proposals that are clear, defensible, and financially grounded.
Communicates status, risks, and team capacity to the Director proactively and in writing, without requiring prompting.
Bridges technical data concepts and business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.
ON-CALL REQUIREMENTS
This position is required to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation. On-call responsibilities include responding to critical incidents, system alerts, and operational emergencies outside of normal business hours. Active participation in the on-call program is a mandatory condition of employment and will be evaluated as part of performance reviews.

WHAT WE OFFER
Work From Home Program (up to 2 days per week upon eligibility)
Modernized Historical Setting in East Sacramento
Free Lot Parking
Paid Time Off
Paid Holidays
Retirements Savings Match
Group Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
Hospital Indemnity Insurance
Life and AD&D Insurance
Long Term Disability Insurance
Accident and Critical Illness Insurance
Flexible Savings Accounts
Paid Community Volunteer Day
Employee Assistance Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program
Employee Referral Program
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Program
This pay scale is an estimate of the salary range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position based on potential employee qualifications, operational needs and other considerations consistent with applicable law. The actual salary may be above or below the range. The pay scale applies only to this position and only if it is filled in Sacramento, California. The pay scale may be different for other positions or in other locations.

ABOUT US
With more than 50 years in business, BHHC has grown from a regional organization to a national insurance group, offering insurance products from coast to coast. Relationships are the cornerstone of our culture, and we believe in doing the right thing. That means we invest in our business in every way possible to deliver on our mission and demonstrate that people are what powers our success. Our commitment to financial strength and integrity means our customers can rest assured that we will be there when it counts.

At BHHC we embrace diversity and foster an environment where our people can be their authentic selves. Our differences make us stronger and better together, which fosters a harmonious workplace—something we truly value. We’ve created an approachable and collaborative atmosphere. Here you’ll find a welcoming workplace where everyone can feel valued, supported, and inspired to do great work. Together, we raise the bar by being curious, remaining customer-focused, and operating with integrity.

title: AI App Lead
description:
Confiz is seeking an AI App Lead in Denver, CO. As the AI Lead you own both the architecture and the hands-on delivery of AI-powered applications built on Databricks, Python, and React. You set technical direction for a team of data, ML, and full-stack engineers while still writing production code yourself.

You will design LLM, RAG, and agentic systems on the Databricks Lakehouse, expose them through Python services, and deliver them to users through React front ends. You build secure, scalable, cost-efficient production solutions, and you are accountable for making sure the code matches the architecture.

Responsibilities

Leads the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions, including LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows, from data ingestion to the user interface.
Designs and builds data and ML pipelines on Databricks using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, and Mosaic AI (Model Serving, Vector Search, Agent Framework).
Builds and reviews production Python services (FastAPI or similar) that expose models, retrieval, and agents through secure, well-documented REST APIs.
Architects and contributes to React (TypeScript) front ends for AI experiences, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, source citations, and human-in-the-loop review screens.
Selects LLM providers and models (e.g., Databricks-hosted foundation models, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) and retrieval options based on quality, latency, cost, and data-governance fit.
Establishes LLMOps and MLOps practices: model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, tracing, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining.
Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex AI applications and is accountable for ensuring the delivered code meets them.
Leads code and architecture reviews, and mentors engineers on RAG, agent design, prompt engineering, and evaluation.
Ensures solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance standards, including Unity Catalog access controls, PII handling, guardrails, audit trails, and responsible AI practices.
Identifies and automates fixes for recurring issues to improve the operational stability and cost efficiency of AI workloads.
Translates business requirements into technical architecture in partnership with product owners and stakeholders, clearly communicating trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering AI/ML systems in production and hands-on work with generative AI.
Demonstrated experience leading engineers and setting technical direction, while remaining hands-on in code.
Advanced Python: production services, async programming, testing, packaging, and PySpark.
Hands-on Databricks Lakehouse experience: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, and Spark-based processing; experience with Model Serving and Vector Search.
Strong React with TypeScript: component architecture, state management, API integration, and streaming or real-time UIs.
Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic systems, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and model fine-tuning.
Proven experience designing scalable distributed systems, REST APIs, and microservices, with a solid grasp of system design and security principles.
Strong SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, and data governance.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP AI and data services.
Hands-on infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), including Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for versioning and deploying jobs, pipelines, and model serving endpoints through CI/CD.
Proficient in CI/CD, Git, automated testing, and the full software development life cycle.
Strong stakeholder communication: able to translate architecture into business value for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Databricks certifications, such as Generative AI Engineer Associate, Machine Learning Professional, or Data Engineer Professional.
Experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Experience with vector databases beyond Databricks Vector Search, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector.
Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Next.js, design systems, and accessible UI development.
Prior experience in client-facing, pre-sales, or solutioning capacity.
Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services.

We have a global team of amazing individuals working on highly innovative enterprise projects & products. Our customer base includes Fortune 100 retail and CPG companies, leading store chains, fast growth fintech, and multiple Silicon Valley startups.

What makes Confiz stand out is our focus on processes and culture. Confiz is ISO 9001:2015 (QMS), ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS), ISO 20000-1:2018 (ITSM) and ISO 14001:2015 (EMS) Certified. We have a vibrant culture of learning via collaboration and making workplace fun.

People who work with us work with cutting-edge technologies while contributing success to the company as well as to themselves.

To know more about Confiz Limited, visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/confiz/

title: Data Engineer
description:
Company Description

Extraordinary opportunity. Exceptional experience.

Sometimes in life, you find yourself in the right place, at the right time, looking at an opportunity so extraordinary it cannot be ignored. At Trucordia, our company is built on wildly successful businesses in our communities across the country, and now we’ve come together to create the next great insurance brokerage. We offer an unrivaled combination of people, tools and solutions, and deliver exceptional experiences and opportunities for our employees, clients and stakeholders.

We celebrate both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities. Ranked as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. for three consecutive years, we have more than 5,000 team members across 200 offices across the country, who actively, genuinely care about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with.

Trucordia Values

We actively, genuinely CARE about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with.
We COLLABORATE continuously because, together, we are more powerful and make amazing things happen for our clients and company.
We LEAD with intelligence, hunger, curiosity, energy and a future-focused attitude of “what’s next”?
We are RESULT-ORIENTED, growth-focused and driven to out-perform expectations of what an insurance brokerage can achieve.
We CELEBRATE both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities.

Job Description

Trucordia is a rapidly growing insurance brokerage that acquires agencies nationwide and brings their business onto shared systems and shared reporting. Every acquired agency arrives with its own systems, its own data, and its own way of counting things. The Data & Analytics team turns that into one answer: a Snowflake warehouse fed from AMS360, Salesforce, HR, and finance systems, etc. modeled in dbt into conformed dimensions and facts (policies, premium, retention, producers, agencies, carriers), and served through Power BI, curated semantic views for AI, and internal web apps we design and build ourselves. Our governance framework (Entra-synced roles, row-level security, network and authentication policies) is code we wrote and maintain.

We are hiring a Data Engineer to help us build and run that platform. This role sits within the Data and Technology organization on the Data & Analytics team, a small, senior group that owns the full path from source system to decision. You will own dbt models and pipelines end to end, onboard new sources, keep the nightly run healthy, and make the platform faster, more trustworthy, and less dependent on any one engineer’s memory. You will work closely with our Integrations team, which migrates acquired agencies into AMS360, and with analysts and stakeholders in Sales, Operations, and Finance.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain dbt models across our staging, intermediate, and mart layers, owning model performance, incremental strategies, tests, and documentation for the areas you take on.
Onboard new sources into Snowflake, from agency management systems to SaaS tools and flat-file feeds, including profiling the data, agreeing on grain and keys with analysts, and writing the loads and quality checks.
Keep the nightly dbt run healthy: diagnose failures, fix root causes, and reduce the blast radius when an upstream source breaks.
Improve observability with freshness checks, row-count and reconciliation tests, and alerting when a source or model drifts from expectations.
Tune Snowflake cost and performance, including warehouse sizing, clustering, query patterns, and task scheduling.
Contribute to our governance framework: role grants, Entra group sync, row-level security policies, and the access-config tables that gate our internal apps.
Build the backend data layer for the internal web apps we ship to the business and support deploys through our CI pipelines.
Partner with analysts and stakeholders to translate a business question into a model that answers it consistently, and document the result in model docs, runbooks, and decision notes in our Azure DevOps wiki.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional experience building production data pipelines, with at least 2 years on a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake strongly preferred).
Strong SQL skills, including reading query plans, window functions, incremental logic, and slowly changing dimensions; comfortable profiling unfamiliar schemas and performing data quality analysis.
Hands-on dbt experience in a production project: models, tests, macros, sources, exposures, and a CI workflow.
Proficiency in Python for data work: loading files, calling APIs, writing small services or scheduled jobs, and testing them.
Experience with Git-based workflows, pull-request review, and CI/CD pipelines.
Sound data modeling judgment: you can explain why a fact table has the grain it does and push back when a request would break it.
Strong written communicator who documents solutions and collaborates effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

AI Assisted Development Requirements:

Proven, ongoing use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily development workflows.
Demonstrated ability to use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, and learning new technologies or codebases.
Ability to critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
Hands-on, habitual experience using AI in professional work, side projects, or personal experimentation; this role assumes AI is a core productivity multiplier.

Nice to have:

Insurance brokerage or agency data experience: policies, premium, commissions, carriers, producers, retention. Familiarity with AMS360, Epic, or similar agency management systems is a real plus.
Salesforce data model and replication into a warehouse.
Snowflake governance features: row access policies, masking, network policies, or SCIM.
Azure ecosystem: Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Functions, Entra ID.
Power BI semantic models, or experience feeding LLM and semantic-layer tools from a warehouse.
FastAPI or another Python web framework.
