title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Secure Developer Platforms (Azure / VDI)
description:
Company Description

Oteemo is an industry-leading technology consulting firm at the forefront of AI-driven, cloud native, enterprise DevSecOps transformation. We build intelligent, automated, secure systems for organizations tackling their toughest technical and business challenges and we're pushing the boundaries of what AI, generative AI, and agentic systems can do in production, not just in theory. Join us and you'll work alongside recognized experts on cutting-edge projects that blend cloud native architecture, extreme automation, and AI/ML at the core. We foster a dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative culture built on continuous learning, where your ideas shape real outcomes for our clients. If you're passionate about building what's next in AI and cloud technology and want to do it with a team that sets the standard rather than follows it, Oteemo is where you belong.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to build a secure, self-service developer sandbox inside a regulated energy utility's Azure tenant. You'll deliver non-persistent, streamed desktops on Azure Virtual Desktop and Omnissa Horizon that rebuild clean at every log off, keep developers' work, and send all traffic through TLS-inspected egress while still booting in under a minute. You'll own the stack from landing zone to golden image.

Key Responsibilities:

Non-Persistent Desktops: Stand up pooled AVD and Omnissa Horizon (instant clone) desktops streamed over HTTPS 443; run the head-to-head POC that selects the platform; persist developer state with FSLogix or Dynamic Environment Manager and App Volumes.

Landing Zone & Inspected Egress: Build hub-and-spoke VNets segmented from production, with forced-tunnel egress through Azure Firewall Premium (TLS inspection, IDPS), private endpoints, and DNS; tune inspection so Git, package managers, GitHub Copilot, and AI/MCP endpoints keep working.

Golden Image & Endpoint Controls: Own the Azure Image Builder or Packer pipeline to Azure Compute Gallery (build, patch, CIS-harden, scan, publish); keep CarbonBlack App Control allow-lists and BeyondTrust EPM working across rebuilds.

Identity, Guardrails & Logging: Enforce guardrails as code with Azure Policy and Terraform or Bicep; wire a non-production identity tenant, per-project RBAC, and Key Vault; forward firewall, desktop, and provisioning logs to Sentinel or Splunk.

Self-Service, AI Agents & Handover: Build ephemeral resource templates with TTL and an orphaned-resource reaper; expose image pipelines so AXIOM AI agents can propose promotions that humans approve; deliver architecture, runbooks, and a support model.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

8+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering, including 4+ years of hands-on Azure in an enterprise or regulated environment.

Virtual Desktop: Delivered at least one production AVD or Omnissa / VMware Horizon deployment, including non-persistent pools, image lifecycle, and FSLogix or DEM / App Volumes at scale.

Azure Networking: Deep experience with VNets, UDRs, Azure Firewall (Premium TLS inspection preferred), Private Link, DNS, and NSGs, including troubleshooting broken TLS chains.

IaC & Identity: Expert Terraform or Bicep run through CI/CD; Packer or Azure Image Builder; Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Policy.

Working knowledge of Windows 11 multi-session hardening and Linux for container workloads; clear writer who can get a design approved by a Cyber Risk reviewer.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications:

Certifications: Azure: AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-140, AZ-305; Terraform Associate; VCP-DTM.

Tuning CarbonBlack App Control, BeyondTrust EPM, CrowdStrike, or Defender for Endpoint for developer workloads.

Additional Information

We Value:

Drive: Passion and energy to implement quality technical solutions. Self-motivation and intellectual curiosity
Commitment to Quality: Passion to conceive and produce world-class solutions that drive real-world value for the customer
Customer Focus: Consultative approach to solving problems for customers. Expectations management.
Communication: Superior communication skills. Ability to clearly articulate problems, solutions, risks, rewards etc. (written and verbal)
Technical Skills: Love for technology. You have to be inherently passionate about technology.
Business Acumen: Technology ultimately is used to enable the business. We look for people who understand how the businesses can be enabled through their technical solutions

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Role Summary

The Senior Data Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and evolving large-scale data platforms and services that power reporting, analytics, and data products across Visa.

This role is focused on building scalable, reliable data pipelines and reusable platform capabilities across modern cloud and big data environments. You will work with technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, and Hive to support batch and real-time data processing at enterprise scale.

Beyond building individual pipelines, you will help improve how data engineering is done across the organization by automating delivery processes, strengthening observability and data quality, establishing engineering standards, and developing reusable frameworks that enable teams to deliver new data products faster and more reliably.

You will work across engineering, analytics, and product teams to solve complex data challenges and help shape the future of Visa's reporting and analytics platforms.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and optimize large-scale data pipelines and data services supporting batch and real-time processing.
Develop scalable solutions using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, and cloud-based data platforms.
Architect data pipelines, data models, and reusable frameworks that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and data products.
Build shared platform capabilities, services, and automation that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams.
Improve data pipeline performance and reliability through performance tuning, workflow optimization, monitoring, and observability.
Automate deployment and delivery processes to improve engineering efficiency and reduce the time required to bring new data capabilities to production.
Establish automated quality gates and validation practices to improve data quality, reliability, and operational stability.
Develop reusable blueprints and engineering patterns for new data services and data products.
Implement and strengthen data governance practices, including data lineage, metadata management, access controls, monitoring, and validation.
Troubleshoot complex performance and reliability issues across distributed data systems and identify opportunities for architectural improvement.
Partner with engineering, analytics, product, and other technical teams to design and deliver end-to-end data solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies, including Generative AI, and identify opportunities to improve data engineering and platform capabilities.
Lead technical initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption, influencing engineering practices across teams.
Mentor engineers and contribute to technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.

What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience designing and building enterprise-scale data platforms, pipelines, or distributed data processing solutions.
Strong experience with technologies such as Spark/PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or comparable big data technologies.
Experience supporting both batch and real-time/streaming data processing.
Experience designing scalable data architectures and solving performance, reliability, and data quality challenges.
Experience building reusable data platforms, frameworks, shared services, or engineering capabilities used across multiple teams.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, observability, and operational reliability.
Experience automating data engineering workflows, deployment pipelines, testing, and quality controls.
Ability to independently diagnose complex distributed-system and data-platform issues and drive them through resolution.
Ability to influence technical direction and drive initiatives across teams without requiring direct authority.
Strong ownership and the ability to move technical initiatives from design through production and broader adoption.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing and operating data platforms at enterprise scale.
Advanced experience with Apache Spark and PySpark, including performance tuning and optimization.
Experience with Kafka or comparable streaming technologies and real-time processing architectures.
Experience with orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.
Experience with Hadoop, Hive, distributed storage, and modern cloud data architectures.
Experience developing automated data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability frameworks.
Experience with data governance capabilities including lineage, metadata management, and access controls.
Experience designing reusable data engineering frameworks, shared services, or self-service platform capabilities.
Experience improving CI/CD and automated delivery practices for data platforms.
Exposure to Generative AI and its application within data engineering or analytics environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

title: Practice Systems & Applied AI: Legal AI Engineer, Corporate
description:
Practice Systems & Applied AI: Legal AI Engineer, Corporate
Information Services Department

Debevoise & Plimpton LLP is a premier law firm with market-leading practices, a global perspective, and strong New York roots. Our clients look to us to bring a distinctively high degree of quality, intensity, and creativity to resolve legal challenges effectively and cost-efficiently. We believe in hiring talented and dedicated individuals as members of our administrative and professional community. We draw on the strength of our culture and structure to deliver the best of our firm to our lawyers and clients through true collaboration.
We are seeking a Legal AI Engineer, Corporate on our Practice Systems & Applied AI team to serve under the direction of the Head of Practice Systems & Applied AI in our Information Services Department. This individual will serve as a senior corporate practice and client advisor responsible for helping lawyers and clients understand, evaluate, and apply artificial intelligence to practice groups in the Corporate Department.

The Legal AI Engineer will lead client-facing AI discussions, identify opportunities within corporate transactions, clients, and matters, and translate complex AI concepts into practical guidance for lawyers, clients, and Firm leadership. The role requires the judgment and credibility to engage directly with Partners, Counsel, Associates, and clients on how AI can be used responsibly to improve corporate legal workflows and client service. This position is intended for an experienced attorney or legal innovation professional with strong knowledge of corporate legal practice and exceptional communication and presentation skills.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

Collaborate with the Head of Practice Systems & Applied AI to execute the Firm’s AI strategy and expand the responsible use of AI across corporate practices and client engagements.
Independently prepare for and lead client-facing presentations, meetings, demonstrations, trainings, and continuing legal education programs on AI concepts, capabilities, risks, and legal use cases.
Serve as a subject-matter expert for lawyers engaging with clients on AI, helping them clearly explain the Firm’s capabilities, approach, governance, and experience.
Advise corporate clients on the practical application of AI within legal departments and matter teams, including use-case development, workflow design, adoption considerations, and responsible-use practices.
Partner directly with Partners, Counsel, and Associates in the Corporate Department to understand legal workflows, identify high-value AI opportunities, and develop practical approaches for integrating AI into corporate client work.
Apply knowledge of corporate legal practice to assess how AI may support drafting, review, diligence, transactions, fundraisings, M&A, capital markets, private equity matters, and other corporate legal processes.
Serve as a hands-on resource for lawyers seeking to use AI on specific matters, including guidance on use-case selection, workflow design, prompt development, quality control, and attorney review.
Develop corporate practice-specific AI guidance, demonstrations, use cases, talking points, playbooks, and training materials for lawyers and client teams.
Support pitches, requests for proposals, client alerts, panel discussions, and other business development efforts by contributing AI-related content and presenting the Firm’s approach to legal AI.
Educate attorneys on how to speak with clients about AI accurately and credibly, including how to discuss capabilities, limitations, risks, governance, and potential value.
Translate legal and client needs into clear business and functional requirements for the Applied AI Engineering & Solutions team and other technical stakeholders.
Support the evaluation and rollout of new AI tools by assessing their relevance to legal practice, developing adoption strategies, and helping lawyers incorporate approved capabilities into their work.
Contribute to the Applied AI roadmap by identifying corporate practice and client priorities, evaluating potential impact, and recommending initiatives for research, development, or implementation.
Prepare communications, briefings, and recommendations for Firm leadership and other stakeholders regarding AI adoption, corporate client activity, practice opportunities, and emerging legal-industry developments.
Stay abreast of advances in AI, legal technology, legal-service delivery, client expectations, professional responsibility, and industry practices to ensure the Firm’s guidance remains current and practical.

QUALIFICATIONS:

J.D. required; minimum of three years working as a practicing attorney, legal innovation professional, knowledge management attorney, practice support attorney, or similar law firm professional.
Demonstrated knowledge of corporate legal practices, transactional matter workflows, attorney work product, and the delivery of legal services in a corporate practice context.
Proven ability to independently lead presentations, meetings, trainings, and substantive discussions with clients, lawyers, and senior stakeholders.
Experience advising lawyers or clients on AI, legal technology, knowledge management, innovation, legal operations, or technology-enabled legal-service delivery.
Strong working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, prompt design, AI-assisted legal workflows, and the opportunities and limitations of AI in legal practice.
Experience developing legal or business requirements and working with technical teams to design, evaluate, or implement technology solutions.
Experience supporting client development, pitches, requests for proposals, client training, or other business development initiatives preferred.
Understanding of confidentiality, privilege, data governance, professional responsibility, privacy, and ethical considerations associated with the use of AI in legal services.
Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial opportunity identification through implementation, adoption, and ongoing support.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

Exceptional presentation and public-speaking skills, with the ability to lead credible and engaging discussions with clients, Partners, Firm leadership, attorneys, and professional staff.
Deep understanding of corporate legal practice areas and the ability to analyze workflows across different corporate matter types, transactions, and stages of legal work.
Strong understanding of AI concepts and legal use cases, with the ability to explain capabilities, limitations, risks, and technical concepts in clear, practical language.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive briefings, client materials, training content, demonstrations, and practice-specific guidance.
Strong judgment, professional credibility, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and navigate sensitive client, practice, and organizational considerations.
Ability to translate legal and corporate client needs into clear use cases, functional requirements, implementation priorities, and recommendations for technical teams.
Strong organizational and project-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple corporate client, practice, training, and implementation initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

TO APPLY:

212.909.8310

title: Sr. Principal UX Engineer
description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation's interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Principal UI/UX Designer to own user experience and interface design inside an Extreme Programming (XP) product team. User research is the heart of this role: you will spend a substantial share of your time with users, running interviews, observation and usability testing, and turning what you learn into designs you ship with engineers every iteration.

Rapid Capabilities is the product development org at Clarity Innovations. A lean team of engineers builds and maintains the company's flagship product suites, Aurora Enterprise and Manifest, and sets the practices for all capability development company-wide. This role is the org's dedicated UX owner, working closely with the Chief Product Manager and engineering leads.

What you'll do
Lead continuous user research as an ongoing part of the job, not a one-time phase: plan and run user interviews, contextual inquiry, field observation and usability tests every iteration.
Build and keep direct, recurring access to users and customer stakeholders, including expert and operational users.
Synthesize findings into personas, journey maps, jobs-to-be-done and opportunity areas the team uses to set priorities.
Turn research into testable hypotheses and user stories with clear UX acceptance criteria, working with the product manager.
Validate designs with real users before and after release; track usability measures (task success, time on task, SUS) and feed results into the backlog.
Make research a team sport: bring engineers into interviews and test sessions, and keep a shared, searchable research repository.
Use AI tools to speed up the design process: synthesizing interview notes and transcripts, drafting research plans and scripts, exploring design variations, and generating working prototypes, while keeping human judgment and real user evidence at the center.
Apply design principles to Department of War (DoW) mission contexts: design for operators and analysts making high-stakes decisions under time pressure, with dense information, in degraded or disconnected environments, and within security and accreditation constraints.
Own end-to-end UX for one or more product areas: flows, information architecture, interaction design and visual UI.
Work as a full member of the XP team: join planning, stand-ups and retrospectives, and pair with engineers on implementation details daily.
Break design work into thin, shippable slices that fit one iteration, rather than delivering large up-front specs.
Prototype quickly (low to high fidelity) to test ideas with users before and during development.
Build and maintain a shared design system and component library with engineering, so UI stays consistent across Aurora Enterprise and Manifest.
Champion accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA or later, Section 508) and usability for complex, data-heavy enterprise and mission workflows.
Required qualifications
5+ years of professional UI/UX or product design experience, with a portfolio that includes research case studies showing how findings changed product direction.
Deep hands-on experience planning, conducting and synthesizing both generative and evaluative research: user interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing and surveys.
Skilled interviewer: asks neutral, open questions, listens actively, and builds rapport with both expert and non-technical users.
Ability to recruit participants and sustain a regular research cadence within short development iterations.
Experience designing enterprise, analytics or data-intensive applications (dashboards, maps, complex forms, workflows).
Practical experience using AI tools (e.g. LLM assistants, AI features in design tools, AI prototyping tools) to speed up research synthesis, ideation and prototyping, with sound judgment about their limits, bias and data-handling risks.
Understanding of DoW use cases (e.g. command and control, intelligence analysis, mission planning, logistics, geospatial workflows) and how core design principles apply there: situational awareness, cognitive load, error prevention, trust in automation, and clarity under stress.
At least 2 years working as an embedded designer on an XP team (pair programming, TDD, short iterations, continuous integration), or a closely equivalent agile practice.
Demonstrated ability to deliver design incrementally and adjust based on feedback from working software.
Strong interaction design, information architecture and visual design skills.
Fluency in a modern design and prototyping tool (e.g. Figma).
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and component-based front-end frameworks, enough to pair productively with engineers.
Clear communication, including presenting research findings persuasively to engineers, product managers and executives.
Preferred qualifications
Formal training or a degree in HCI, human factors, cognitive psychology, anthropology or a related field.
Experience researching with hard-to-reach users (operators, analysts, field personnel) or in restricted environments.
Experience with quantitative methods: product analytics, survey design, A/B testing.
Experience setting up research operations: participant panels, consent processes, research repositories.
Experience creating or scaling a design system used by multiple products.
Familiarity with Lean UX, design studios, or story mapping.
Ability to contribute front-end code directly (e.g. React, TypeScript, CSS).
Experience designing AI-assisted or LLM-powered interfaces.
Direct experience on DoW programs, including research with warfighters, operators or analysts in mission or exercise settings.
Active security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one (if required for the position).
IC4 level expectations

At IC4 you are a senior individual contributor who works independently and raises the design bar for the teams around you.

Dimension

Expectation

Scope

Owns UX for a full product area or product suite, not just individual features

Research

Sets the research agenda for that area, chooses methods, and keeps a regular cadence of direct user contact

Autonomy

Sets own research and design direction; needs little day-to-day guidance

Influence

Uses research evidence to shape roadmap and backlog decisions with product and engineering leads

Quality

Defines UX standards and design system patterns others follow

Mentorship

Coaches engineers and junior designers on research and usability practice

Ambiguity

Turns unclear customer problems into testable design hypotheses

How we work

Our teams practice XP, and design is part of the team rather than a hand-off before it.

Research every iteration: the team talks to users each cycle, and what we learn drives the backlog.
Short iterations: design, build and review in one- to two-week cycles.
Pairing: designers pair with engineers on UI implementation and with product on story writing.
Whole team: design, product and engineering plan, estimate, sit in on user sessions, and retro together.
Small releases: ship thin slices to users often and learn from real usage.
Sustainable pace: steady, predictable delivery over heroics.

Salary Range: $93,000 - $255,000

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
